meanings.example: After the heavy rain, there was a flood in the basement.
meanings.example_cn: 大雨过后，地下室被水淹了。

meanings.definition: To fill or cover an area with water.
meanings.example: Heavy rain can flood the playground and make big puddles everywhere.
meanings.example_cn: 大雨会淹没操场，到处都是大水坑。

meanings.definition: Powder made from grain for baking.
meanings.example: We need flour to bake cookies for the class party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们需要面粉来烤班级派对吃的饼干。

meanings.definition: To clean something by running water over it.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to flush the toilet after you use it.
meanings.example_cn: 用完马桶后，别忘了冲水。

meanings.definition: A musical instrument you blow into.
meanings.example: She played a pretty song on her flute during the concert.
meanings.example_cn: 音乐会上，她用长笛吹了一首好听的曲子。

meanings.definition: To pay close attention.
meanings.example: I need to focus on my homework so I can finish it quickly.
meanings.example_cn: 我需要专心做作业，这样才能快点做完。

meanings.definition: The main thing people are paying attention to.
meanings.example: The focus of today’s lesson is how plants grow.
meanings.example_cn: 今天这节课的重点是植物是怎么生长的。

meanings.definition: A thick, low cloud near the ground.
meanings.example: The morning fog made it hard to see the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 早晨的雾让人看不清操场。

meanings.definition: To cover something so it is hard to see, like with mist.
meanings.example: The cold air made my glasses fog up when I walked outside.
meanings.example_cn: 我走到外面时，冷空气让我的眼镜蒙上了一层雾。

meanings.definition: To bend something so one part covers another.
meanings.example: Please fold your clothes before putting them away.
meanings.example_cn: 收衣服前，请先把衣服叠好。

meanings.definition: A line or bend made when you double paper or cloth.
meanings.example: I made a neat fold in my paper to start an origami crane.
meanings.example_cn: 我在纸上折了一道整齐的折痕，开始折千纸鹤。

meanings.definition: Something people or animals eat.
meanings.example: Pizza is my favorite food for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 披萨是我晚餐最喜欢吃的食物。

meanings.definition: A silly or foolish person.
meanings.example: He acted like a fool by putting the bucket on his head and making us laugh.
meanings.example_cn: 他把水桶扣在头上逗我们笑，表现得像个傻瓜。

meanings.definition: To trick someone or make them believe something that is not true.
meanings.example: April Fool’s Day is a time when people try to fool their friends with silly tricks.
meanings.example_cn: 愚人节这天，大家会用小把戏捉弄自己的朋友。

meanings.definition: To not remember.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to bring your lunch to school!
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了带午饭去学校！

meanings.definition: A shape or type of something.
meanings.example: Clouds can take the form of animals if you use your imagination.
meanings.example_cn: 发挥想象力的话，云可以变成各种动物的形状。

meanings.definition: To make or shape something.
meanings.example: Let’s form a circle and play a game together.
meanings.example_cn: 我们围成一圈，一起做游戏吧。

meanings.definition: Toward the front.
meanings.example: Please step forward when your name is called.
meanings.example_cn: 叫到你名字的时候，请往前走一步。

meanings.definition: At or toward the front.
meanings.example: Please move to the forward seats on the bus so everyone can get on.
meanings.example_cn: 请坐到公交车靠前的座位上，好让大家都能上车。

meanings.definition: Not costing money.
meanings.example: The lemonade at the fair is free for everyone!
meanings.example_cn: 集市上的柠檬水对所有人免费！

meanings.definition: Not held, controlled, or stopped by anyone.
meanings.example: The puppy broke free from his leash and ran around the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗挣脱了牵引绳，在院子里跑来跑去。

meanings.definition: To let someone or something go.
meanings.example: The zookeeper will free the injured bird back into the wild.
meanings.example_cn: 动物园管理员会把这只受伤的鸟放归大自然。

meanings.definition: To turn into ice.
meanings.example: If you leave water outside in the winter, it will freeze into ice.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天把水放在外面，它会冻成冰。

meanings.definition: A time when the weather is very cold and things get icy.
meanings.example: After the freeze last night, the grass was covered in frost.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚冻过之后，草地上都结了霜。

meanings.definition: New, not old or stale.
meanings.example: We picked fresh strawberries from the garden this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 今天早上我们从花园里摘了新鲜的草莓。

meanings.definition: A sudden fear.
meanings.example: The loud thunder gave me a fright in the middle of the night.
meanings.example_cn: 半夜里响亮的雷声吓了我一跳。

meanings.definition: The part that faces forward.
meanings.example: The front of our house has a bright red door.
meanings.example_cn: 我们房子的正面有一扇鲜红的门。

meanings.definition: White ice crystals that form when it is very cold.
meanings.example: There was frost on the grass when I woke up today.
meanings.example_cn: 我今天早上醒来时，草地上有霜。

meanings.definition: To cover something with a thin layer of ice or sweet icing.
meanings.example: I love to frost cupcakes with chocolate icing.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢给小蛋糕抹上巧克力糖霜。

meanings.definition: To cook in hot oil.
meanings.example: Let’s fry some eggs for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我们早餐煎几个鸡蛋吧。

meanings.definition: Material burned to make heat or energy.
meanings.example: Cars need fuel like gas to make them go.
meanings.example_cn: 汽车需要汽油这样的燃料才能跑起来。

meanings.definition: To give power or energy to something, like a car or a fire.
meanings.example: We need to fuel the car before our road trip.
meanings.example_cn: 我们公路旅行前需要给车加油。

meanings.definition: Something that is enjoyable or playful.
meanings.example: We had so much fun playing tag at recess.
meanings.example_cn: 课间玩抓人游戏，我们玩得特别开心。

meanings.definition: Enjoyable and making you happy.
meanings.example: The water park is so fun that I never want to leave.
meanings.example_cn: 水上乐园太好玩了，我都不想走了。

meanings.definition: Makes you laugh.
meanings.example: That joke was so funny, I couldn’t stop giggling!
meanings.example_cn: 那个笑话太好笑了，我忍不住一直咯咯笑！

meanings.definition: Strange or unusual in a way that is not normal.
meanings.example: The milk tasted funny, so I didn’t drink it.
meanings.example_cn: 这牛奶味道怪怪的，所以我没喝。

meanings.definition: The soft hair on an animal.
meanings.example: The cat’s fur is soft and warm.
meanings.example_cn: 猫的毛又软又暖和。

meanings.definition: Covered with soft hair.
meanings.example: My teddy bear is the softest, most furry toy I have.
meanings.example_cn: 我的泰迪熊是我拥有的最软、毛最蓬松的玩具。

meanings.definition: More.
meanings.example: We had to walk further to reach the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 我们得再走一段路才能到操场。

meanings.definition: At a longer distance away.
meanings.example: We walked further down the trail to find the waterfall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们沿着小路再走远一点，去找瀑布。

meanings.definition: A space or opening.
meanings.example: Mind the gap between the train and the platform when you get on.
meanings.example_cn: 上车时，小心火车和站台之间的缝隙。

meanings.definition: A substance like air.
meanings.example: We filled the balloon with gas so it could float up to the ceiling.
meanings.example_cn: 我们给气球充了气，它就能飘到天花板上。

meanings.definition: To fill something, like a car, with fuel.
meanings.example: We stopped at the station to gas up the car before heading home.
meanings.example_cn: 回家前我们在加油站停了一下，给车加满油。

meanings.definition: A door in a fence or wall.
meanings.example: Please close the gate so the puppy doesn’t run outside.
meanings.example_cn: 请关上大门，别让小狗跑到外面去。

meanings.definition: To come together.
meanings.example: Let’s gather around the table for story time.
meanings.example_cn: 我们围到桌子旁边来听故事吧。

meanings.definition: To collect things or bring them together.
meanings.example: Let’s gather all the blocks and put them back in the box.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把所有积木收集起来，放回箱子里吧。

meanings.definition: A small lizard that can climb walls.
meanings.example: A tiny gecko climbed up the wall in our classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 教室里有一只小壁虎爬上了墙。

meanings.definition: A kind or type of art, music, or book.
meanings.example: My favorite genre of movie is adventure because it’s exciting.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的电影类型是冒险片，因为很刺激。

meanings.definition: A tiny living thing that can cause illness.
meanings.example: Washing your hands helps get rid of germs that can make you sick.
meanings.example_cn: 洗手能帮你赶走让你生病的细菌。

meanings.definition: The spirit of a dead person.
meanings.example: We told a spooky ghost story at the sleepover.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在过夜聚会上讲了一个吓人的鬼故事。

meanings.definition: A person or thing that is much bigger than normal.
meanings.example: An elephant is a giant compared to a mouse.
meanings.example_cn: 和老鼠比起来，大象就是个庞然大物。

meanings.definition: Very large in size.
meanings.example: We saw a giant pumpkin at the fair that was bigger than a chair!
meanings.example_cn: 我们在集市上看到一个比椅子还大的巨型南瓜！

meanings.definition: Happy or pleased.
meanings.example: I was so glad when my friend came to my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我的朋友来参加我的生日聚会，我特别高兴。

meanings.definition: A hard, clear material.
meanings.example: Please be careful with that glass cup so it doesn’t break.
meanings.example_cn: 拿那个玻璃杯时小心点，别打碎了。

meanings.definition: A cup or container made out of glass that you drink from.
meanings.example: I poured myself a glass of milk before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 睡觉前我给自己倒了一杯牛奶。

meanings.definition: To fly smoothly and gently through the air without flapping wings or using much effort.
meanings.example: The ice skater can glide smoothly across the frozen pond.
meanings.example_cn: 滑冰的人能在结冰的湖面上平稳地滑行。

meanings.definition: A round model of the Earth showing continents, oceans, and countries.
meanings.example: We spun the globe to find where Australia is.
meanings.example_cn: 我们转动地球仪，找澳大利亚在哪里。

meanings.definition: To shine with a soft light.
meanings.example: The fireflies glow in the dark when we go camping.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去露营时，萤火虫在黑暗中发光。

meanings.definition: A soft, gentle light.
meanings.example: There was a gentle glow from the nightlight in my room.
meanings.example_cn: 我房间里的小夜灯发出柔和的光。

meanings.definition: A sticky substance used to stick things together.
meanings.example: Use glue to stick the pieces of your craft project together.
meanings.example_cn: 用胶水把你手工课作品的各部分粘起来。

meanings.definition: To stick things together using glue.
meanings.example: Please glue the pieces of your project together and let them dry.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你作品的各部分粘在一起，然后晾干。

meanings.definition: An animal with horns and a beard.
meanings.example: The goat at the petting zoo tried to nibble my shoelaces!
meanings.example_cn: 亲子动物园里的那只山羊总想啃我的鞋带！

meanings.definition: A being that people worship.
meanings.example: Many people pray to God in their own special way.
meanings.example_cn: 很多人会用自己特别的方式向上帝祈祷。

meanings.definition: A game played by hitting a ball into holes with clubs.
meanings.example: Dad likes to play golf on the weekends with his friends.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸周末喜欢和朋友们一起打高尔夫。

meanings.definition: A large water bird.
meanings.example: We saw a goose and her babies swimming at the pond.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在池塘边看到一只鹅带着小鹅在游泳。

meanings.definition: A small seed from plants like wheat or rice.
meanings.example: We learned that bread is made from grain like wheat.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学到面包是用小麦这样的谷物做的。

meanings.definition: A small unit used to measure weight.
meanings.example: A paperclip weighs about one gram.
meanings.example_cn: 一个回形针大约重一克。

meanings.definition: Very big and impressive.
meanings.example: The castle looked grand with its tall towers and golden gates.
meanings.example_cn: 这座城堡有高高的塔楼和金色的大门，看起来很气派。

meanings.definition: A drawing that shows numbers or amounts.
meanings.example: We made a graph to show how many apples each student likes.
meanings.example_cn: 我们画了一张图，展示每个同学喜欢吃多少苹果。

meanings.definition: To draw a picture that shows numbers or information.
meanings.example: We learned how to graph the results of our science experiment.
meanings.example_cn: 我们学了怎么用图表展示科学实验的结果。

meanings.definition: A metal rack for cooking over heat.
meanings.example: We cooked hamburgers on the grill at the family picnic.
meanings.example_cn: 家庭野餐时，我们在烤架上烤汉堡包。

meanings.definition: To cook food over direct heat, like on a barbecue.
meanings.example: My dad likes to grill hamburgers outside in the summer.
meanings.example_cn: 我爸爸夏天喜欢在外面烤汉堡包。

meanings.definition: Tiny pieces of sand or stone.
meanings.example: Tiny bits of grit got in my shoes when I walked on the sandy path.
meanings.example_cn: 我走在沙地上时，细小的沙砾钻进了鞋里。

meanings.definition: To press your teeth together, usually because you are angry or in pain.
meanings.example: I had to grit my teeth when the doctor gave me a shot.
meanings.example_cn: 医生给我打针时，我不得不咬紧牙关。

meanings.definition: Courage or strength to keep going, even when it’s hard.
meanings.example: It takes a lot of grit to keep practising even when things get hard.
meanings.example_cn: 就算事情变难了，也要继续练习，这需要很大的毅力。

meanings.definition: The surface of the earth.
meanings.example: We sat on the ground to have our picnic lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐在地上吃野餐午餐。

meanings.definition: A piece of land or the surface of the earth.
meanings.example: We sat on the ground and had a picnic in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐在公园的地上野餐。

meanings.definition: To punish someone by not letting them go out.
meanings.example: Mom will ground me if I don’t finish my homework on time.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我不准时完成作业，妈妈就会罚我不许出门。

meanings.definition: To get bigger or older.
meanings.example: The puppy will grow into a big dog someday.
meanings.example_cn: 这只小狗将来会长成一只大狗。

meanings.definition: To help plants get bigger.
meanings.example: If you water your plant every day, it will grow tall and green.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你每天给植物浇水，它就会长得又高又绿。

meanings.definition: To change over time.
meanings.example: A small idea can grow into a big project over time.
meanings.example_cn: 一个小小的想法，久而久之会变成一个大项目。

meanings.definition: To try to answer without being sure.
meanings.example: Can you guess what’s inside the wrapped box?
meanings.example_cn: 你能猜出这个包装好的盒子里是什么吗？

meanings.definition: An answer you choose when you are not sure.
meanings.example: My guess is that there are twenty candies in the jar.
meanings.example_cn: 我猜罐子里有二十颗糖果。

meanings.definition: Someone invited to visit or stay.
meanings.example: We had a special guest visit our class and read us a story.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班来了一位特别的客人，给我们读了一个故事。

meanings.definition: A chewy sweet or candy.
meanings.example: Chewing bubble gum can make a really big bubble.
meanings.example_cn: 嚼泡泡糖能吹出很大的泡泡。

meanings.definition: The pink soft part in your mouth around your teeth.
meanings.example: The dentist checks your gum to make sure it’s healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 牙医会检查你的牙龈，确保它是健康的。

meanings.definition: A weapon that shoots bullets.
meanings.example: The police officer showed us that a gun is not a toy and should never be touched.
meanings.example_cn: 警察叔叔告诉我们枪不是玩具，绝对不能碰。

meanings.definition: Something you do over and over again, like brushing your teeth every day.
meanings.example: Brushing your teeth twice a day is a good habit.
meanings.example_cn: 每天刷两次牙是个好习惯。

meanings.definition: A big room or building where people meet for parties or events.
meanings.example: We all met in the school hall for the assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 我们都在学校礼堂集合参加集会。

meanings.definition: A tool you use to hit nails into wood.
meanings.example: Dad used a hammer to hang a picture on the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸用锤子把一幅画挂到墙上。

meanings.definition: To hit something using a hammer.
meanings.example: Let’s hammer the nails into this piece of wood.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把钉子敲进这块木头里吧。

meanings.definition: The part of something that you hold onto.
meanings.example: Please hold the bucket by the handle so it doesn’t spill.
meanings.example_cn: 提桶时请握住把手，别让水洒出来。

meanings.definition: To take care of a problem or situation.
meanings.example: Mom will handle the problem if the computer stops working.
meanings.example_cn: 如果电脑坏了，妈妈会来处理这个问题。

meanings.definition: Very useful.
meanings.example: A flashlight is handy to have when the power goes out.
meanings.example_cn: 停电的时候，手电筒派上大用场。

meanings.definition: Good at fixing things or making things work.
meanings.example: Uncle Jim is so handy, he can fix almost anything.
meanings.example_cn: 吉姆叔叔手很巧，几乎什么都能修。

meanings.definition: To attach something at the top so it dangles or swings.
meanings.example: Let’s hang the decorations from the ceiling for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把装饰品挂在天花板上，准备开派对。

meanings.definition: Damage to someone’s body or feelings.
meanings.example: Running with scissors can cause harm, so be careful.
meanings.example_cn: 拿着剪刀跑会伤人，所以要小心。

meanings.definition: To hurt someone or something.
meanings.example: Never harm animals; always be gentle and kind to them.
meanings.example_cn: 绝对不要伤害动物，永远要温柔、友善地对待它们。

meanings.definition: The fruits or vegetables that are picked at the end of the growing season.
meanings.example: We picked apples during the fall harvest.
meanings.example_cn: 秋天收获的时候，我们摘了苹果。

meanings.definition: To gather crops or plants when they are ready.
meanings.example: We harvest apples from the orchard every fall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们每年秋天从果园里收苹果。

meanings.definition: Doing something very quickly.
meanings.example: In his haste to finish, he spilled juice on his paper.
meanings.example_cn: 他急着做完，结果把果汁洒在了纸上。

meanings.definition: To really, really not like something or someone.
meanings.example: I hate getting up early on cold mornings.
meanings.example_cn: 我讨厌在寒冷的早上早起。

meanings.definition: A very strong feeling of not liking something or someone.
meanings.example: He felt hate for broccoli until he tried it with cheese.
meanings.example_cn: 他本来讨厌西兰花，直到他配着奶酪尝了一口。

meanings.definition: A bird with sharp claws and a hooked beak that hunts other animals.
meanings.example: A hawk soared high in the sky looking for food.
meanings.example_cn: 一只鹰在高空中翱翔，寻找食物。

meanings.definition: How hot something is.
meanings.example: The heat from the sun made the sand too hot to walk on.
meanings.example_cn: 太阳的热度把沙子晒得太烫，没法在上面走。

meanings.definition: To make something warmer or hot.
meanings.example: Can you heat my soup in the microwave, please?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我用微波炉热一下汤吗？

meanings.definition: A row of bushes planted close together like a fence.
meanings.example: A green hedge grows along the edge of our yard.
meanings.example_cn: 一排绿色的树篱沿着我们院子的边缘长着。

meanings.definition: The back part of your foot.
meanings.example: My new shoes hurt the heel of my foot.
meanings.example_cn: 我的新鞋磨脚后跟。

meanings.definition: The back part of the shoe, underneath your foot, that is thicker or raised.
meanings.example: The heel of Sarah’s shoe made her a little taller when she wore them to the party.
meanings.example_cn: 萨拉鞋子的鞋跟让她穿上去参加派对时，个子显得高了一点。

meanings.definition: To make things easier for someone or do something for them.
meanings.example: Can you help me tie my shoes?
meanings.example_cn: 你能帮我系鞋带吗？

meanings.definition: To make a difficult or painful situation better, easier, or less painful.
meanings.example: Putting ice on my sore knee helped the pain go away faster.
meanings.example_cn: 给我疼的膝盖敷冰，帮助疼痛更快消失。

meanings.definition: Aid or something that makes things easier.
meanings.example: Thank you for your help with my math homework.
meanings.example_cn: 谢谢你辅导我的数学作业。

meanings.definition: A grown-up female chicken.
meanings.example: The brown hen laid three eggs this morning.
meanings.example_cn: 那只棕色的母鸡今天早上下了三个蛋。

meanings.definition: A group of cows or other animals that move together.
meanings.example: We watched a herd of cows grazing in the field.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看到一群牛在田野里吃草。

meanings.definition: To gather animals together into a group.
meanings.example: The farmer will herd the cows into the barn at sunset.
meanings.example_cn: 日落时，农民会把牛赶回牛棚。

meanings.definition: A brave person who helps or saves others.
meanings.example: The firefighter was a hero for saving the puppy from the fire.
meanings.example_cn: 这位消防员从火里救出了小狗，是个英雄。

meanings.definition: Belongs to a girl or woman.
meanings.example: That pink backpack is hers, not mine.
meanings.example_cn: 那个粉色的背包是她的，不是我的。

meanings.definition: To put something where no one can see it.
meanings.example: Let’s hide the birthday present under the bed so no one finds it.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把生日礼物藏到床底下，这样没人能找到。

meanings.definition: The skin of an animal, usually after it has been removed.
meanings.example: The cowboy wore boots made from snake hide.
meanings.example_cn: 这个牛仔穿的靴子是用蛇皮做的。

meanings.definition: To go for a long walk, usually in nature.
meanings.example: On Saturday, we will hike up the mountain trail with our family.
meanings.example_cn: 星期六，我们会和家人一起沿山路徒步。

meanings.definition: A long walk, usually for fun or exercise.
meanings.example: We went on a hike through the woods to see the waterfall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们徒步穿过树林，去看瀑布。

meanings.definition: A small clue to help someone figure something out.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a hint about where she hid the cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈给了我一点提示，告诉我她把饼干藏哪儿了。

meanings.definition: To suggest something in a gentle or indirect way.
meanings.example: Dad will hint at what my birthday present is, but he won’t tell me.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会暗示我的生日礼物是什么，但不会直接告诉我。

meanings.definition: The part of your body below your waist on each side.
meanings.example: She wore a belt around her hip to hold up her pants.
meanings.example_cn: 她在髋部系了一条腰带，把裤子提住。

meanings.definition: A large animal from Africa with thick skin and a big mouth.
meanings.example: At the zoo, the hippo splashed water with its big mouth.
meanings.example_cn: 在动物园里，河马用它的大嘴把水溅得到处都是。

meanings.definition: To make a sharp sound like a snake.
meanings.example: The snake will hiss if it feels scared or angry.
meanings.example_cn: 蛇感到害怕或生气时会发出嘶嘶声。

meanings.definition: A sharp sound, like air escaping or a snake.
meanings.example: The snake made a loud hiss when it was scared.
meanings.example_cn: 蛇害怕时发出很响的嘶嘶声。

meanings.definition: To make a sharp sound, like when someone or something is upset or angry.
meanings.example: The cat gave a hiss when the dog got too close.
meanings.example_cn: 狗靠得太近时，猫发出了一声嘶叫。

meanings.definition: Something you like to do for fun in your free time.
meanings.example: Drawing pictures is my favorite hobby after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后画画是我最喜欢的爱好。

meanings.definition: An empty space or opening in something solid.
meanings.example: There was a hole in my sock, so my toe stuck out.
meanings.example_cn: 我的袜子上有个洞，脚趾露出来了。

meanings.definition: A tool with a curved end for hanging or catching things.
meanings.example: Hang your coat on the hook by the door.
meanings.example_cn: 把你的外套挂在门边的钩子上。

meanings.definition: To catch or grab something with a hook.
meanings.example: I tried to hook my backpack onto the chair, but it kept falling off.
meanings.example_cn: 我想把背包挂到椅子上，可它一直掉下来。

meanings.definition: A long, bendy tube for moving water.
meanings.example: We used a hose to water the garden on a hot day.
meanings.example_cn: 天气热的时候，我们用水管浇花园。

meanings.definition: To spray water using a hose.
meanings.example: Let’s hose down the muddy dog before he comes inside.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用水管把这只满身泥的狗冲干净，再让它进屋。

meanings.definition: A place where people stay when they are away from home.
meanings.example: We stayed at a hotel by the beach during our vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 我们度假时住在海边的一家酒店里。

meanings.definition: Used when asking about the way something happens.
meanings.example: Can you show me how to tie my shoes?
meanings.example_cn: 你能教我怎么系鞋带吗？

meanings.definition: Used when asking about the amount of something.
meanings.example: How much ice cream do you want?
meanings.example_cn: 你想要多少冰淇淋？

meanings.definition: Used when asking about someone’s feelings.
meanings.example: How are you feeling after your first day at school?
meanings.example_cn: 上学第一天结束后，你感觉怎么样？

meanings.definition: To put your arms around someone to show you care.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a big hug before I left for school.
meanings.example_cn: 我上学出门前，妈妈给了我一个大大的拥抱。

meanings.definition: A warm squeeze or embrace with your arms.
meanings.example: After I fell, Mom gave me a big hug to help me feel better.
meanings.example_cn: 我摔倒后，妈妈给了我一个大大的拥抱，让我感觉好一点。

meanings.definition: Very, very big.
meanings.example: There was a huge pumpkin at the county fair.
meanings.example_cn: 县集市上有一个巨大的南瓜。

meanings.definition: To make a low, steady sound, like buzzing.
meanings.example: She likes to hum her favorite songs while drawing.
meanings.example_cn: 她画画时喜欢哼自己最喜欢的歌。

meanings.definition: A low, steady sound that keeps going.
meanings.example: There was a soft hum from the refrigerator in the kitchen.
meanings.example_cn: 厨房里的冰箱发出轻轻的嗡嗡声。

meanings.definition: A person.
meanings.example: Every human needs food, water, and sleep to stay healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 每个人都需要食物、水和睡眠来保持健康。

meanings.definition: Not thinking you are better than other people.
meanings.example: Even though he won the race, he stayed humble and thanked his teammates.
meanings.example_cn: 虽然他赢了比赛，但他保持谦虚，感谢了队友。

meanings.definition: To search for and try to catch or kill animals.
meanings.example: The cat likes to hunt for mice in the barn.
meanings.example_cn: 猫喜欢在谷仓里抓老鼠。

meanings.definition: The act of searching for or chasing animals.
meanings.example: The hunters prepared for the hunt early in the morning.
meanings.example_cn: 猎人们一大早就为这次狩猎做好准备。

meanings.definition: To looking carefully for something you want to find.
meanings.example: The detectives hunt for clues to solve the mystery.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探们搜寻线索，解开这个谜团。

meanings.definition: To cause someone pain or injury.
meanings.example: Be careful not to hurt your finger when you close the door.
meanings.example_cn: 关门时小心别夹到手指。

meanings.definition: Feeling pain or having something that is painful.
meanings.example: She felt hurt when her friend forgot her birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友忘了她的生日，她感到很伤心。

meanings.definition: A small, simple house.
meanings.example: We built a small hut out of sticks and leaves in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在后院用树枝和树叶搭了一个小棚子。

meanings.definition: Frozen water that is hard and cold.
meanings.example: The pond was covered with ice, so we went skating.
meanings.example_cn: 池塘结了冰，所以我们去滑冰了。

meanings.definition: To cover a cake with sweet icing.
meanings.example: Let’s ice the cupcakes with blue frosting for the party.
meanings.example_cn: 我们给纸杯蛋糕抹上蓝色糖霜，用来派对吧。

meanings.definition: Covered with ice.
meanings.example: The sidewalk was icy and slippery after the snowstorm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雪过后，人行道上结了冰，很滑。

meanings.definition: Very cold and slippery, often covered with ice.
meanings.example: Be careful on the icy stairs so you don’t slip and fall.
meanings.example_cn: 结冰的楼梯上要小心，别滑倒摔跤。

meanings.definition: To deliberately pay no attention to someone or something.
meanings.example: Try to ignore the noise and finish your homework.
meanings.example_cn: 试着不理那些噪音，把作业做完。

meanings.definition: Feeling unwell or in poor health.
meanings.example: She stayed home from school because she felt ill.
meanings.example_cn: 她感觉不舒服，所以待在家里没去上学。

meanings.definition: To form a picture in your mind.
meanings.example: Imagine you could fly like a bird above the clouds!
meanings.example_cn: 想象一下你能像鸟一样在云层上面飞！

meanings.definition: To picture something in your mind or think it could happen.
meanings.example: Imagine what it would be like to fly like a bird.
meanings.example_cn: 想象一下像鸟一样飞会是什么感觉。

meanings.definition: A small unit of length, about 2.5 centimeters.
meanings.example: The caterpillar was only an inch long as it crawled across the leaf.
meanings.example_cn: 毛毛虫在叶子上爬的时候，只有一英寸长。

meanings.definition: To move very slowly, just a little at a time.
meanings.example: The turtle began to inch closer to the lettuce, bit by bit.
meanings.example_cn: 乌龟一点点地向生菜挪近。

meanings.definition: When germs like bacteria or viruses get into your body and make you sick.
meanings.example: The doctor gave me medicine to help me get better from my ear infection.
meanings.example_cn: 医生给我开了药，帮我治好耳朵感染。

meanings.definition: To hurt or damage part of the body.
meanings.example: Be careful on the playground so you don’t injure your knee.
meanings.example_cn: 在操场上要小心，别伤到膝盖。

meanings.definition: Colored liquid used for writing or drawing.
meanings.example: I spilled blue ink all over my drawing by accident.
meanings.example_cn: 我不小心把蓝墨水洒得满画都是。

meanings.definition: To teach someone how to do something.
meanings.example: The dance teacher will instruct us on how to twirl.
meanings.example_cn: 舞蹈老师会教我们怎么转圈。

meanings.definition: To tell someone what to do or give an order.
meanings.example: The coach will instruct us on how to play the new game.
meanings.example_cn: 教练会教我们怎么玩这个新游戏。

meanings.definition: Wanting to know or do something.
meanings.example: He has a strong interest in dinosaurs and can name many kinds.
meanings.example_cn: 他对恐龙有浓厚的兴趣，能说出好多种类。

meanings.definition: To make someone want to pay attention or learn more.
meanings.example: Dinosaur books really interest my little sister.
meanings.example_cn: 恐龙的书真的很吸引我的小妹妹。

meanings.definition: The extra money you pay when you borrow money.
meanings.example: If you borrow money from the bank, you have to pay interest on the loan.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你向银行借钱，就得为贷款付利息。

meanings.definition: A strong, hard metal that is often used to make things.
meanings.example: The gate was made out of strong iron bars.
meanings.example_cn: 大门是用结实的铁条做的。

meanings.definition: To smooth out wrinkles in clothes using an iron.
meanings.example: I have to iron my shirt so it looks nice for the picture.
meanings.example_cn: 我得熨一下衬衫，拍照片时才好看。

meanings.definition: A glass container.
meanings.example: We put cookies in a big glass jar on the counter.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把饼干放在台面上一个大玻璃罐里。

meanings.definition: Pants made from strong blue denim.
meanings.example: I wore my favorite blue jeans to the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我穿着最喜欢的蓝色牛仔裤去公园。

meanings.definition: To connect or link things together so they become one.
meanings.example: You can join the two pieces of paper with glue.
meanings.example_cn: 你可以用胶水把两张纸粘起来。

meanings.definition: To become part of a group or activity.
meanings.example: Would you like to join our game of tag?
meanings.example_cn: 你想加入我们的抓人游戏吗？

meanings.definition: Shared by two or more people.
meanings.example: We had a joint birthday party because our birthdays are close together.
meanings.example_cn: 因为我们的生日离得近，我们办了一场联合生日派对。

meanings.definition: A spot where two things are connected or meet.
meanings.example: My finger joint hurts when I bend it too far.
meanings.example_cn: 我把手指弯得太狠时，指关节就疼。

meanings.definition: Great happiness and pleasure.
meanings.example: Winning the soccer game filled our team with joy.
meanings.example_cn: 赢了足球比赛，我们全队都充满喜悦。

meanings.definition: The liquid from fruits and vegetables.
meanings.example: I drank a glass of orange juice with my breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我早餐喝了一杯橙汁。

meanings.definition: To squeeze liquid out of fruit or vegetables.
meanings.example: Let’s juice these oranges to make fresh orange juice.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把这些橙子榨成新鲜橙汁吧。

meanings.definition: Containing a lot of juice and tasting moist.
meanings.example: The watermelon was so juicy that it dripped down my chin.
meanings.example_cn: 西瓜汁太多了，顺着我下巴往下滴。

meanings.definition: Old things that are not useful anymore.
meanings.example: We cleaned the garage and threw away a lot of old junk.
meanings.example_cn: 我们打扫车库，扔掉了好多旧破烂。

meanings.definition: To throw something away because it is not needed.
meanings.example: We decided to junk the broken bike because it couldn’t be fixed.
meanings.example_cn: 我们决定把坏了的自行车扔掉，因为修不好了。

meanings.definition: To have and not let go.
meanings.example: I want to keep this shell I found on the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我想把在海滩上捡到的这个贝壳留下来。

meanings.definition: To continue doing something.
meanings.example: Keep practicing the piano every day and you’ll get better.
meanings.example_cn: 每天坚持练钢琴，你就会越来越好。

meanings.definition: To store or hold onto something.
meanings.example: Please keep your shoes in the closet.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的鞋子收进壁橱里。

meanings.definition: A small metal tool used to open locks.
meanings.example: She used a key to unlock the front door.
meanings.example_cn: 她用钥匙打开了前门。

meanings.definition: To enter words or numbers by typing them on a keyboard.
meanings.example: Please key your name into the computer to sign in.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的名字输进电脑里登录。

meanings.definition: Very important or essential.
meanings.example: It’s key to remember your homework so you don’t fall behind in class.
meanings.example_cn: 记住做作业很关键，这样你才不会在课上落后。

meanings.definition: To make something or someone die.
meanings.example: The bug spray will kill any ants that come inside.
meanings.example_cn: 杀虫剂会杀死爬进来的蚂蚁。

meanings.definition: To touch someone with your lips to show love or affection.
meanings.example: Dad gave me a kiss on the forehead before bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 睡觉前，爸爸在我额头上亲了一下。

meanings.definition: Touching someone with your lips to show love or care.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a goodnight kiss before I went to sleep.
meanings.example_cn: 我睡觉前，妈妈给了我一个晚安吻。

meanings.definition: A light frame covered with paper or cloth that you fly in the wind on a string.
meanings.example: It was a windy day, perfect for flying a bright red kite.
meanings.example_cn: 今天风很大，正好放一只鲜红色的风筝。

meanings.definition: A small fuzzy brown fruit.
meanings.example: I like to eat kiwi because it’s sweet and a little sour.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢吃猕猴桃，因为它甜甜的，带一点酸。

meanings.definition: To go down and rest on your knees.
meanings.example: We kneel in the garden to plant seeds in the dirt.
meanings.example_cn: 我们跪在花园里，把种子种进土里。

meanings.definition: To hit a surface to make a noise.
meanings.example: Please knock on the door before coming in.
meanings.example_cn: 进来之前请先敲门。

meanings.definition: A sound or action made by hitting something, usually a door.
meanings.example: I heard a knock at the door while I was doing my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我做作业时听到有人敲门。

meanings.definition: A way of tying rope or string.
meanings.example: Tie your shoelaces in a double knot so they don’t come undone.
meanings.example_cn: 把鞋带系成双结，这样就不会松开了。

meanings.definition: To tie a piece of string, rope, or ribbon so it cannot come undone easily.
meanings.example: Let me knot your shoelaces so they don’t come undone.
meanings.example_cn: 我来帮你把鞋带系紧，这样就不会松了。

meanings.definition: A tangled or tied part in rope, string, or hair.
meanings.example: There was a tight knot in my shoelace that I couldn’t untie.
meanings.example_cn: 我的鞋带缠了一个紧紧的结，解不开。

meanings.definition: A string for tying shoes or clothes.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to tie the lace on your shoes before running.
meanings.example_cn: 跑步前别忘了系好鞋带。

meanings.definition: To tie or fasten with shoelaces or strings.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to lace your shoes before you run outside.
meanings.example_cn: 跑出去之前别忘了系好鞋带。

meanings.definition: A pretty and delicate fabric with lots of holes and patterns.
meanings.example: The edge of the dress was decorated with pretty white lace.
meanings.example_cn: 裙子的边上装饰着漂亮的白色蕾丝。

meanings.definition: A boy or young man.
meanings.example: The young lad wore a red cap and ran through the field.
meanings.example_cn: 那个年轻小伙子戴着红帽子，在田野里跑。

meanings.definition: A woman, especially one who is polite or of high status.
meanings.example: A kind lady helped me find my lost puppy.
meanings.example_cn: 一位好心的女士帮我找到了走失的小狗。

meanings.definition: An object that gives light.
meanings.example: I turned on my lamp to read a book at bedtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我睡前打开台灯看书。

meanings.definition: All the visible features in a stretch of land or a painting that shows outdoor scenery.
meanings.example: The painting showed a beautiful landscape of mountains and rivers.
meanings.example_cn: 这幅画画的是美丽的山水风景。

meanings.definition: To plan and design how a yard or garden will look.
meanings.example: Dad wants to landscape the yard by planting new flowers and bushes.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸想在院子里种上新花和灌木，把院子美化一下。

meanings.definition: A narrow road.
meanings.example: Stay in your lane while you ride your bike on the road.
meanings.example_cn: 在路上骑自行车时，待在你的车道里。

meanings.definition: The flat area on top of your legs when you sit.
meanings.example: The cat curled up and slept on my lap while I watched TV.
meanings.example_cn: 我看电视时，猫蜷在我腿上睡觉。

meanings.definition: To drink something using your tongue, like a cat does.
meanings.example: The puppy will lap up water from his bowl when he’s thirsty.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗渴了会舔着喝碗里的水。

meanings.definition: Going around a track one time in a race.
meanings.example: She finished the first lap of the race in record time.
meanings.example_cn: 她以创纪录的时间跑完了第一圈。

meanings.definition: A girl or young woman.
meanings.example: The lass wore a pretty dress and danced at the fair.
meanings.example_cn: 那个姑娘穿着漂亮的裙子，在集市上跳舞。

meanings.definition: A simple lock on a door or gate.
meanings.example: Please close the gate and make sure the latch is locked.
meanings.example_cn: 请关上大门，确认锁扣扣好了。

meanings.definition: To fasten or close something with a latch.
meanings.example: Please latch the gate so the dog doesn’t get out.
meanings.example_cn: 请扣好大锁，别让狗跑出去。

meanings.definition: Happening after the present moment and not immediately.
meanings.example: We can play outside later after we finish our homework.
meanings.example_cn: 我们做完作业后可以到外面去玩。

meanings.definition: Hot, melted rock that comes out of a volcano.
meanings.example: Hot lava flowed from the volcano during the eruption.
meanings.example_cn: 火山喷发时，滚烫的熔岩流了出来。

meanings.definition: An area of short grass in a yard or park.
meanings.example: I helped Dad mow the lawn on Saturday morning.
meanings.example_cn: 星期六早上我帮爸爸割草坪。

meanings.definition: To let liquid or gas escape through a hole or crack.
meanings.example: The roof has a leak, so water drips in when it rains.
meanings.example_cn: 屋顶漏了，一下雨水就滴进来。

meanings.definition: To let secret information out so others can find out.
meanings.example: Someone might leak the surprise party plans if we’re not careful.
meanings.example_cn: 我们不小心点的话，有人可能会把惊喜派对的计划泄露出去。

meanings.definition: A hole or crack where liquid or gas escapes.
meanings.example: There’s a leak in the roof that lets water drip into the attic.
meanings.example_cn: 屋顶有个漏缝，水一滴一滴渗进阁楼。

meanings.definition: To gain knowledge or skills.
meanings.example: I want to learn how to ride a bike without training wheels.
meanings.example_cn: 我想学怎么不用辅助轮骑自行车。

meanings.definition: To find out new things or gain knowledge.
meanings.example: I want to learn how to ride a bike this summer.
meanings.example_cn: 这个夏天我想学骑自行车。

meanings.definition: The smallest amount or the lowest level.
meanings.example: I got the least amount of candy because I came last in the game.
meanings.example_cn: 我游戏最后一个到，所以拿到的糖最少。

meanings.definition: To let someone use something for a while and expect it back.
meanings.example: Can you lend me your pencil? I promise to give it back.
meanings.example_cn: 你能借我你的铅笔吗？我保证还你。

meanings.definition: A smaller amount or not as much.
meanings.example: Take less milk if you are not very thirsty.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你不是很渴，就少喝点牛奶。

meanings.definition: To touch with the tongue.
meanings.example: The dog likes to lick my hand when he’s happy.
meanings.example_cn: 狗开心的时候喜欢舔我的手。

meanings.definition: When you touch something with your tongue.
meanings.example: The cat gave the kitten a gentle lick on its head.
meanings.example_cn: 猫温柔地舔了一下小猫的头。

meanings.definition: A cover for a container.
meanings.example: Put the lid on the jar so the cookies stay fresh.
meanings.example_cn: 把盖子盖在罐子上，饼干才不会受潮。

meanings.definition: To rest flat on something.
meanings.example: I like to lie on the grass and look at the clouds.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢躺在草地上看云。

meanings.definition: To say something that is not true.
meanings.example: It’s not nice to lie about taking the last cookie.
meanings.example_cn: 拿了最后一块饼干还撒谎，这不好。

meanings.definition: A statement that is not true.
meanings.example: Telling a lie can get you into trouble.
meanings.example_cn: 撒谎会让你惹上麻烦。

meanings.definition: To enjoy or feel happy about something.
meanings.example: I like going to the zoo to see the animals.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢去动物园看动物。

meanings.definition: Similar to something else.
meanings.example: My new shoes are like the ones my friend has.
meanings.example_cn: 我的新鞋和我朋友的那双很像。

meanings.definition: An arm, leg, or wing.
meanings.example: The monkey swung from one limb of the tree to another.
meanings.example_cn: 猴子从一棵树的树枝荡到另一棵树枝。

meanings.definition: A big branch growing from a tree.
meanings.example: A squirrel ran across the limb of the tree in our yard.
meanings.example_cn: 一只松鼠从我们院子里那棵树的树枝上跑过。

meanings.definition: The point where something stops or cannot go further.
meanings.example: There is a limit to how many cookies you can have.
meanings.example_cn: 你能吃多少块饼干是有限制的。

meanings.definition: To keep something from going past a certain point.
meanings.example: The teacher will limit the number of cookies each student can have.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会限制每个同学能拿的饼干数量。

meanings.definition: A connection between things.
meanings.example: There’s a strong link between eating healthy food and feeling good.
meanings.example_cn: 吃健康食物和感觉良好之间有紧密的联系。

meanings.definition: To join or connect things together.
meanings.example: Let’s link hands and make a circle for our game.
meanings.example_cn: 我们手拉手围成一圈做游戏吧。

meanings.definition: A single ring in a chain.
meanings.example: One link in the chain was broken, so the gate wouldn’t close.
meanings.example_cn: 链条上有一个环断了，所以大门关不上。

meanings.definition: The soft edge of your mouth.
meanings.example: She put a little bit of jelly on her bottom lip.
meanings.example_cn: 她在下嘴唇上抹了一点果冻。

meanings.definition: The edge or rim of a cup or glass.
meanings.example: Don’t spill your juice over the lip of the cup.
meanings.example_cn: 别把果汁洒到杯子外面。

meanings.definition: To pay attention to sounds or someone speaking.
meanings.example: Please listen carefully to the story so you can answer questions.
meanings.example_cn: 请认真听故事，这样才能回答问题。

meanings.definition: A unit for measuring liquids, about as much as a big water bottle.
meanings.example: We bought a litre of orange juice for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我们早餐买了一升橙汁。

meanings.definition: A large organ in the body that helps process food and remove waste.
meanings.example: The doctor checks your liver to make sure it’s healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 医生会检查你的肝脏，确保它是健康的。

meanings.definition: Something being carried.
meanings.example: The donkey carried a heavy load of apples in baskets.
meanings.example_cn: 驴子用篮子驮着重重的苹果。

meanings.definition: To put things into or onto something, like a truck or cart.
meanings.example: Help me load the groceries into the car, please.
meanings.example_cn: 请帮我把买的杂货搬进车里。

meanings.definition: Money or something given to someone to use and return later.
meanings.example: The bank gave Dad a loan to buy a new car.
meanings.example_cn: 银行贷款给爸爸买了一辆新车。

meanings.definition: To let someone borrow something that must be given back later.
meanings.example: Can you loan me your pencil until lunchtime?
meanings.example_cn: 你能借我你的铅笔用到午饭时间吗？

meanings.definition: A device that keeps doors, boxes, or gates closed and can be opened with a key.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to use the lock on your bike when you park it at school.
meanings.example_cn: 在学校停车时，别忘了给自行车上锁。

meanings.definition: To close something with a lock so it cannot be opened easily.
meanings.example: Remember to lock your bike when you leave it outside.
meanings.example_cn: 把车停在外面时，记得给自行车上锁。

meanings.definition: To write down or record something on a list.
meanings.example: I need to log my reading hours for the summer challenge.
meanings.example_cn: 我需要记录下暑假挑战的阅读时长。

meanings.definition: A written record of events, activities, or information, often kept regularly.
meanings.example: The captain wrote in the ship’s log about what happened during the day.
meanings.example_cn: 船长在航海日志里写下了当天发生的事。

meanings.definition: A thick piece of wood from a tree.
meanings.example: We sat on a log by the campfire and roasted marshmallows.
meanings.example_cn: 我们坐在篝火旁的一根木头上烤棉花糖。

meanings.definition: A shape that bends around and crosses itself, like a circle.
meanings.example: Make a loop with your string before tying your shoes.
meanings.example_cn: 系鞋带前先用线绕一个圈。

meanings.definition: To make a round shape or curve.
meanings.example: Loop the ribbon around the box to make a bow.
meanings.example_cn: 把丝带绕着盒子打个蝴蝶结。

meanings.definition: A series of actions or events that repeats over and over without stopping.
meanings.example: The roller coaster went in a loop and made everyone scream with excitement.
meanings.example_cn: 过山车绕了一个圈，把大家都激动得尖叫起来。

meanings.definition: A large truck for carrying goods.
meanings.example: A big red lorry delivered food to the grocery store.
meanings.example_cn: 一辆红色大卡车给杂货店送来了食物。

meanings.definition: To not have something anymore because you can’t find it or it was taken.
meanings.example: Be careful not to lose your mittens at recess.
meanings.example_cn: 课间休息时小心别把手套弄丢了。

meanings.definition: When you lose something or someone.
meanings.example: The loss of her favorite toy made her very sad.
meanings.example_cn: 她最喜欢的玩具丢了，让她非常伤心。

meanings.definition: The sad feeling you have when you lose something or someone.
meanings.example: I felt a loss when I lost my favorite toy.
meanings.example_cn: 我弄丢了最喜欢的玩具时，感到很难过。

meanings.definition: A strong, warm feeling of caring for someone or something.
meanings.example: I have so much love for my family and friends.
meanings.example_cn: 我非常爱我的家人和朋友。

meanings.definition: To care about someone or something very much.
meanings.example: I love playing soccer with my friends after school.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢放学后和朋友们一起踢足球。

meanings.definition: A person in a romantic relationship.
meanings.example: In the story, the prince was a true lover who cared deeply for the princess.
meanings.example_cn: 故事里，王子是一位真心爱人，深深爱着公主。

meanings.definition: Good or bad things that happen by chance.
meanings.example: We had good luck and found the last piece of the puzzle under the couch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们运气真好，在沙发底下找到了拼图的最后一块。

meanings.definition: A meal eaten in the middle of the day.
meanings.example: My favorite lunch is a turkey sandwich and apple slices.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的午餐是火鸡三明治配苹果片。

meanings.definition: To eat a meal in the middle of the day.
meanings.example: Let’s lunch together in the cafeteria today.
meanings.example_cn: 我们今天在食堂一起吃午饭吧。

meanings.definition: The organ in your chest that helps you breathe.
meanings.example: Taking deep breaths is good for your lung health.
meanings.example_cn: 深呼吸对肺的健康有好处。

meanings.definition: Feeling extremely angry.
meanings.example: I felt mad when my brother took my toy without asking.
meanings.example_cn: 弟弟没问我就拿了我的玩具，我很生气。

meanings.definition: Not thinking clearly.
meanings.example: She was so mad after losing her toy that she wasn’t thinking clearly.
meanings.example_cn: 她丢了玩具后气坏了，脑子都不清楚了。

meanings.definition: Acting in a wild way.
meanings.example: The kids ran around the playground like mad, laughing and shouting.
meanings.example_cn: 孩子们在操场上疯跑，又笑又叫。

meanings.definition: The power to make impossible things happen using special tricks or forces.
meanings.example: The magician used magic to make the rabbit disappear.
meanings.example_cn: 魔术师用魔法把兔子变没了。

meanings.definition: Someone who creates or makes things.
meanings.example: The toy maker designed a new robot for kids to play with.
meanings.example_cn: 玩具制造商设计了一款新机器人给孩子们玩。

meanings.definition: Being a boy or a man.
meanings.example: The male puppy has a blue collar, and the female puppy has a pink one.
meanings.example_cn: 公小狗戴蓝色项圈，母小狗戴粉色项圈。

meanings.definition: A boy or a man.
meanings.example: The peacock is a male because it has bright, colorful feathers.
meanings.example_cn: 这只孔雀是公的，因为它有鲜艳多彩的羽毛。

meanings.definition: A place with many shops and restaurants together.
meanings.example: We went to the mall to shop for new shoes and have lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去商场买新鞋，还在那里吃了午饭。

meanings.definition: A large number of.
meanings.example: There are so many stars in the sky at night.
meanings.example_cn: 夜空中有这么多星星。

meanings.definition: To become someone’s husband or wife.
meanings.example: My aunt and uncle will marry in a big ceremony next summer.
meanings.example_cn: 我姑姑和姑父明年夏天会办一场盛大的婚礼。

meanings.definition: Something worn on the face to hide or protect it.
meanings.example: At Halloween, I wore a spooky mask that covered my whole face.
meanings.example_cn: 万圣节时，我戴了一个吓人的面具，把整张脸都遮住了。

meanings.definition: To cover or hide something so it cannot be seen.
meanings.example: She used sunglasses to mask her tired eyes.
meanings.example_cn: 她用墨镜遮住疲惫的眼睛。

meanings.definition: A small rug or thick piece placed on the floor or table.
meanings.example: Please wipe your feet on the mat before coming inside.
meanings.example_cn: 进来之前请在垫子上把脚擦干净。

meanings.definition: The study of numbers, shapes, and patterns using rules and symbols.
meanings.example: We learn about shapes and numbers in our maths class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在数学课上学形状和数字。

meanings.definition: A topic, problem, or situation being talked about.
meanings.example: If you have a problem, talk to a teacher about the matter.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你有问题，找老师谈谈这件事。

meanings.definition: To be important.
meanings.example: It doesn’t matter if you make a mistake; just try again.
meanings.example_cn: 犯错没关系，再试一次就好。

meanings.definition: To make a difference.
meanings.example: It doesn’t matter if we win or lose, as long as we have fun.
meanings.example_cn: 我们输赢不重要，只要玩得开心就好。

meanings.definition: Used to say something is possible but not certain.
meanings.example: Maybe we can go to the zoo this weekend if it doesn’t rain.
meanings.example_cn: 如果不下雨，这周末我们也许能去动物园。

meanings.definition: Food eaten at one time, like breakfast or dinner.
meanings.example: Breakfast is my favorite meal because I love pancakes.
meanings.example_cn: 早餐是我最喜欢的一餐，因为我爱吃煎饼。

meanings.definition: A doctor or person trained to help sick or hurt people.
meanings.example: A medic arrived quickly to help the boy who fell off his bike.
meanings.example_cn: 医护人员很快赶来帮助从自行车上摔下来的男孩。

meanings.definition: To see and talk to someone.
meanings.example: I can’t wait to meet my new baby cousin.
meanings.example_cn: 我迫不及待要见到我的小表弟了。

meanings.definition: To turn from solid to liquid, usually by heating.
meanings.example: The ice cream will melt if you don’t eat it quickly.
meanings.example_cn: 你不快点吃的话，冰淇淋会化掉。

meanings.definition: A list of foods and drinks you can order at a restaurant.
meanings.example: I chose spaghetti from the menu at the restaurant.
meanings.example_cn: 我在餐厅的菜单上选了意大利面。

meanings.definition: Kindness or forgiveness shown to someone who could be punished.
meanings.example: The coach showed mercy and let us rest after running laps.
meanings.example_cn: 教练大发慈悲，让我们跑完圈后休息一下。

meanings.definition: Cheerful and full of joy.
meanings.example: Everyone was merry and singing at the holiday party.
meanings.example_cn: 节日聚会上大家都高高兴兴地唱歌。

meanings.definition: A dirty or untidy state.
meanings.example: There was a mess of toys all over the floor after playtime.
meanings.example_cn: 玩完玩具后，地板上到处都是乱七八糟的玩具。

meanings.definition: To make something messy or untidy.
meanings.example: Don’t mess up your room after we just cleaned it.
meanings.example_cn: 我们刚打扫完，别把房间又弄乱了。

meanings.definition: Not clean or organized.
meanings.example: My room is messy when I forget to put away my clothes.
meanings.example_cn: 我忘记收衣服时，房间就乱糟糟的。

meanings.definition: A hard, shiny material like iron or gold that can carry heat and electricity.
meanings.example: The playground slide is made of shiny metal.
meanings.example_cn: 操场滑梯是用发亮的金属做的。

meanings.definition: A unit for measuring length, about as long as a guitar.
meanings.example: The swimming pool is twenty metres long.
meanings.example_cn: 游泳池有二十米长。

meanings.definition: The part of you that thinks, feels, and remembers.
meanings.example: Close your eyes and use your mind to imagine a magical place.
meanings.example_cn: 闭上眼睛，用你的大脑想象一个神奇的地方。

meanings.definition: To be careful about something or watch out for it.
meanings.example: Please mind the wet floor so you don’t slip and fall.
meanings.example_cn: 请小心湿地，别滑倒摔跤。

meanings.definition: Belonging to me.
meanings.example: This blue water bottle is mine.
meanings.example_cn: 这个蓝色水杯是我的。

meanings.definition: To dig into the ground to take out valuable things like coal, gold, or other minerals.
meanings.example: Every day, the workers mine for coal deep beneath the ground.
meanings.example_cn: 工人们每天在地下深处开采煤炭。

meanings.definition: A place where people dig into the ground to take out valuable things like minerals, coal, gold, or other rocks.
meanings.example: The workers went deep into the mine to dig for gold and precious stones.
meanings.example_cn: 工人们深入矿井，挖掘黄金和宝石。

meanings.definition: Extremely small in size.
meanings.example: She brought a mini cupcake for snack time.
meanings.example_cn: 她带了一个迷你小蛋糕当加餐。

meanings.definition: A small plant with a cool, fresh taste.
meanings.example: I love the taste of mint in my chewing gum.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢口香糖里薄荷的味道。

meanings.definition: Glass that you can see yourself in.
meanings.example: She looked in the mirror to brush her hair.
meanings.example_cn: 她对着镜子梳头。

meanings.definition: To copy how something looks or performs.
meanings.example: The robot was designed to mirror the way humans move and talk.
meanings.example_cn: 这个机器人被设计成模仿人类走路和说话的样子。

meanings.definition: To reflect.
meanings.example: The shiny surface of the car mirrors the sunlight on a bright day.
meanings.example_cn: 晴天时，汽车光亮的表面反射着阳光。

meanings.definition: Great unhappiness or suffering.
meanings.example: Being stuck inside all weekend was pure misery for me.
meanings.example_cn: 整个周末都被困在屋里，对我来说简直是受罪。

meanings.definition: To not catch, hit, or see something.
meanings.example: I didn’t catch the ball and was sad to miss the catch.
meanings.example_cn: 我没接到球，因为没接住而难过。

meanings.definition: To feel sad because someone you care about is not there.
meanings.example: I always miss my grandma when she goes back home after visiting us.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶看完我们回老家后，我总是很想她。

meanings.definition: A title for a girl or woman.
meanings.example: Miss Wilson is our new music teacher this year.
meanings.example_cn: 威尔逊老师是我们这学年新的音乐老师。

meanings.definition: Thin fog close to the ground made of tiny drops of water.
meanings.example: The mist made it hard to see the playground in the morning.
meanings.example_cn: 早晨的薄雾让人看不清操场。

meanings.definition: To cover something with a fine spray of water or mist.
meanings.example: Let’s mist the plants with water so their leaves stay fresh.
meanings.example_cn: 我们给植物喷点水，让叶子保持新鲜。

meanings.definition: Something that is not correct.
meanings.example: It was a mistake to forget my lunch at home.
meanings.example_cn: 把午饭忘在家里是个错误。

meanings.definition: To get something wrong or think something is true when it is not.
meanings.example: I sometimes mistake salt for sugar when baking if I’m not careful.
meanings.example_cn: 烘焙时如果不小心，我有时会把盐当成糖。

meanings.definition: To put things together.
meanings.example: Let’s mix the flour and eggs to make pancakes.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把面粉和鸡蛋混在一起做煎饼吧。

meanings.definition: A group of different things put together.
meanings.example: The snack bowl was a mix of pretzels, nuts, and raisins.
meanings.example_cn: 加餐碗里混合着脆饼干、坚果和葡萄干。

meanings.definition: To make fun of someone in a mean way.
meanings.example: It’s not nice to mock someone just because they made a mistake.
meanings.example_cn: 不能因为别人犯了错就取笑人家，这不好。

meanings.definition: The way someone feels at a certain time.
meanings.example: She was in a happy mood because it was her birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 今天是她生日，所以她心情很好。

meanings.definition: Often changing from happy to unhappy or upset.
meanings.definition_cn: 喜怒无常的；情绪多变的
meanings.example: My brother can be moody—sometimes he laughs, and sometimes he gets upset for no reason.
meanings.example_cn: 我弟弟情绪多变——有时哈哈大笑，有时无缘无故就不高兴。

meanings.definition: A greater amount or a larger number.
meanings.example: Can I have more juice, please?
meanings.example_cn: 请再给我一点果汁好吗？

meanings.definition: The greatest amount or the largest number.
meanings.example: She has the most stickers in our class collection.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班集邮里，她的贴纸最多。

meanings.definition: Movement from one place to another.
meanings.example: The swing moved back and forth in a smooth motion.
meanings.example_cn: 秋千平稳地前后摆动。

meanings.definition: To use a movement, like your hand, to signal someone.
meanings.example: The coach will motion for you to run when it’s your turn.
meanings.example_cn: 轮到你的时候，教练会示意你跑。

meanings.definition: A film or story shown on a screen.
meanings.example: We watched a funny movie with popcorn on Friday night.
meanings.example_cn: 星期五晚上我们一边吃爆米花一边看了一部搞笑电影。

meanings.definition: A large amount.
meanings.example: There isn’t much milk left in the fridge.
meanings.example_cn: 冰箱里剩下的牛奶不多了。

meanings.definition: To a great degree or very.
meanings.example: I love you very much.
meanings.example_cn: 我非常爱你。

meanings.definition: Covered in or full of mud.
meanings.example: My shoes got muddy after I played soccer in the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 我在雨中踢完球，鞋子上沾满了泥。

meanings.definition: Not clear or hard to see through.
meanings.example: The river water looked muddy after the big rainstorm.
meanings.example_cn: 大暴雨过后，河水看起来很浑浊。

meanings.definition: A large cup with a handle.
meanings.example: I drank hot chocolate from my favorite mug with a big handle.
meanings.example_cn: 我用我最喜欢的、带大把手的马克杯喝热巧克力。

meanings.definition: A mother.
meanings.example: My mum always reads me a bedtime story.
meanings.example_cn: 我妈妈总是给我念睡前故事。

meanings.definition: A mother.
meanings.example: The little girl hugged her mummy before going to school.
meanings.example_cn: 小女孩上学前抱了抱她的妈妈。

meanings.definition: A dead body from long ago that was wrapped and preserved.
meanings.example: We saw a real mummy at the museum wrapped in old bandages.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在博物馆里看到一具真的木乃伊，缠着古老的绷带。

meanings.definition: When someone is killed on purpose and it’s against the law.
meanings.example: The detective in the book solved a murder mystery.
meanings.example_cn: 书里的侦探破解了一桩谋杀谜案。

meanings.definition: To kill someone in a way that is against the law.
meanings.example: The detective solved the mystery of who tried to murder the character in the story.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探破解了故事里谁试图谋杀主角的谜案。

meanings.definition: A plant-like fungus with a cap and stem, sometimes eaten as food.
meanings.example: We found a big mushroom growing in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在花园里发现了一棵长出来的大蘑菇。

meanings.definition: To grow or spread very quickly.
meanings.example: The number of students in the club began to mushroom after they won the contest.
meanings.example_cn: 俱乐部赢得比赛后，会员人数开始快速增长。

meanings.definition: A thin, pointed metal piece hammered into wood.
meanings.example: Dad hammered a nail into the wall to hang a picture.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸把钉子敲进墙里，挂一幅画。

meanings.definition: To attach or fix something using a nail.
meanings.example: Let’s nail this picture frame to the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把这个画框钉到墙上吧。

meanings.definition: The hard part at the tip of your finger or toe.
meanings.example: I painted each nail on my hand a different color.
meanings.example_cn: 我把手上每个指甲都涂成了不同的颜色。

meanings.definition: A short sleep during the day.
meanings.example: I took a nap on the couch after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我在沙发上小睡了一会儿。

meanings.definition: To sleep for a short time during the day.
meanings.example: I like to nap on the couch after playing outside.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完后，我喜欢在沙发上小睡一会儿。

meanings.definition: The part of the military that works at sea.
meanings.example: My uncle works in the navy and sails on big ships.
meanings.example_cn: 我叔叔在海军工作，在大船上航行。

meanings.definition: Clean, tidy, or organized.
meanings.example: Please keep your desk neat so you can find your homework easily.
meanings.example_cn: 请保持课桌整洁，这样你就能轻松找到作业。

meanings.definition: Clever or smart.
meanings.example: That’s a neat trick you can do with your yo-yo!
meanings.example_cn: 你用悠悠球能玩出这么厉害的花招！

meanings.definition: Nice, tidy, or organized.
meanings.example: Your handwriting is so neat and easy to read.
meanings.example_cn: 你的字写得真整齐，很好认。

meanings.definition: A place built by birds or animals to lay eggs or live in.
meanings.example: A bird built a nest in the tree outside my window.
meanings.example_cn: 一只鸟在我窗外的树上筑了个巢。

meanings.definition: To build a home, usually for birds.
meanings.example: We watched the birds nest in the tree outside our window.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看着鸟儿在窗外的树上筑巢。

meanings.definition: Material made of threads with holes, used for catching or holding things.
meanings.example: We used a net to catch butterflies in the garden.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在花园里用网捉蝴蝶。

meanings.definition: To catch something using a net.
meanings.example: The fisherman tried to net some fish for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 渔夫想网几条鱼当晚餐。

meanings.definition: Information about things that have happened recently.
meanings.example: Dad reads the news every morning to find out what’s happening in the world.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸每天早上看新闻，了解世界上发生的事。

meanings.definition: Pleasant, kind.
meanings.example: It was nice of you to share your snack with me.
meanings.example_cn: 你愿意和我分享零食，真好。

meanings.definition: Enjoyable.
meanings.example: We had a nice picnic in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在公园的野餐很开心。

meanings.definition: The daughter of your brother or sister.
meanings.example: My niece loves to draw pictures for me when she visits.
meanings.example_cn: 我侄女来看我的时候，喜欢给我画画。

meanings.definition: Unwanted or loud sound.
meanings.example: The noise from the construction outside made it hard to hear the teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 外面施工的噪音大得让人听不清老师说话。

meanings.definition: Any sound, especially a loud or unwanted one.
meanings.example: There was so much noise in the cafeteria that I could barely hear my friend.
meanings.example_cn: 食堂里太吵了，我几乎听不见朋友说话。

meanings.definition: The middle of the day at twelve o’clock.
meanings.example: We always eat lunch at noon when the clock strikes twelve.
meanings.example_cn: 时钟敲十二下的时候，我们总是在中午吃午饭。

meanings.definition: Used after “neither” to add another negative idea.
meanings.example: Neither the cat nor the dog wanted to go outside in the rain.
meanings.example_cn: 猫和狗都不想冒着雨出门。

meanings.definition: The direction found at the top of most maps and opposite to south.
meanings.example: We drove north to visit Grandma, who lives at the top of the state.
meanings.example_cn: 我们往北开车去看奶奶，她住在州的北边。

meanings.definition: To do what you are told or follow rules.
meanings.example: You should always obey the rules at school.
meanings.example_cn: 在学校你应该一直遵守规则。

meanings.definition: A thing you can see or touch.
meanings.example: A pencil is an object you use to write with.
meanings.example_cn: 铅笔是你用来写字的东西。

meanings.definition: To say you do not agree with something.
meanings.example: I object to having homework on weekends because I want more playtime.
meanings.example_cn: 我反对周末布置作业，因为我想多玩一会儿。

meanings.definition: Strange or unusual.
meanings.example: It was odd to see snow in the middle of summer.
meanings.example_cn: 大夏天看到下雪真奇怪。

meanings.definition: Not even, like a number that cannot be divided by two.
meanings.example: The number seven is an odd number because it can’t be divided by two.
meanings.example_cn: 数字七是奇数，因为它不能被二整除。

meanings.definition: To hurt someone’s feelings or make them upset.
meanings.example: I didn’t mean to offend you with my joke.
meanings.example_cn: 我不是有意用这个玩笑冒犯你的。

meanings.definition: A thick, slippery liquid from plants or the ground.
meanings.example: We put oil in the pan before frying the eggs.
meanings.example_cn: 煎鸡蛋之前我们在锅里放了油。

meanings.definition: A liquid that is used as fuel for machines or for cooking.
meanings.example: We used some oil to cook the eggs for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 我们用了一些油来做早餐的煎蛋。

meanings.definition: A small green or black fruit with a pit.
meanings.example: My pizza had a green olive on each slice.
meanings.example_cn: 我的披萨每一片上都有一颗青橄榄。

meanings.definition: At one time in the past.
meanings.example: Once, I saw a shooting star while camping.
meanings.example_cn: 有一次露营的时候，我看到了一颗流星。

meanings.definition: Happening one single time.
meanings.example: I went to Disneyland once when I was little.
meanings.example_cn: 我小时候去过一次迪士尼乐园。

meanings.definition: As soon as something happens.
meanings.example: Once you finish your homework, you can watch TV.
meanings.example_cn: 你一做完作业，就可以看电视。

meanings.definition: A large black-and-white whale, also called a killer whale.
meanings.example: We saw an orca jump out of the water at the aquarium.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在水族馆看到一头虎鲸跃出水面。

meanings.definition: A part of the body that does a special job.
meanings.example: The heart is an organ that pumps blood through your body.
meanings.example_cn: 心脏是把血液泵到全身的器官。

meanings.definition: A playful animal that lives in water and has thick fur.
meanings.example: The otter slid down the muddy riverbank and splashed into the water.
meanings.example_cn: 水獭从泥泞的河岸滑下来，扑通一声扎进水里。

meanings.definition: Belonging to us.
meanings.example: This soccer ball is ours, so let’s put our name on it.
meanings.example_cn: 这个足球是我们的，我们把名字写上去吧。

meanings.definition: A box-shaped machine used for baking or heating food.
meanings.example: The cookies are baking in the oven right now.
meanings.example_cn: 饼干现在正在烤箱里烤着。

meanings.definition: A group or bundle of things put together.
meanings.example: A pack of wolves howled at the moon.
meanings.example_cn: 一群狼对着月亮嚎叫。

meanings.definition: To put things into a bag or suitcase.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to pack your toothbrush in your suitcase before we leave.
meanings.example_cn: 出门前别忘了把牙刷装进箱子里。

meanings.definition: One side of a sheet of paper in a book.
meanings.example: Turn to page ten in your book.
meanings.example_cn: 把书翻到第十页。

meanings.definition: A single sheet of paper in a book or notebook.
meanings.example: I turned the page of my book to see what happened next.
meanings.example_cn: 我翻过一页书，想看看接下来发生了什么。

meanings.definition: An unpleasant feeling that hurts.
meanings.example: He felt pain in his knee after falling on the playground.
meanings.example_cn: 在操场上摔倒之后，他膝盖很疼。

meanings.definition: To cover something with color using a brush.
meanings.example: Let’s paint the fence a bright yellow color.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把篱笆刷成亮黄色吧。

meanings.definition: A colored liquid used to make pictures or cover walls.
meanings.example: We used bright paint to make colorful pictures in art class.
meanings.example_cn: 美术课上我们用鲜艳的颜料画出五颜六色的画。

meanings.definition: Two things that go together or match.
meanings.example: I bought a new pair of shoes for school.
meanings.example_cn: 我为上学买了一双新鞋。

meanings.definition: To put two things together to make a set.
meanings.example: Let’s pair the socks so we don’t lose any in the laundry.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把袜子配好吧，免得洗衣服时丢了。

meanings.definition: A good friend.
meanings.example: My pal and I built a fort in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我和好朋友在后院搭了一个小堡垒。

meanings.definition: The inside part of your hand.
meanings.example: Place the coin in the palm of your hand.
meanings.example_cn: 把硬币放在你的手掌心里。

meanings.definition: A flat metal dish used for cooking.
meanings.example: Mom fried eggs in a pan for breakfast.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈早餐用平底锅煎了鸡蛋。

meanings.definition: A black-and-white bear-like animal from China.
meanings.example: We saw a panda eating bamboo at the zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在动物园看到一只熊猫在吃竹子。

meanings.definition: A public march or procession with people celebrating or showing things.
meanings.example: We watched the parade with colorful floats and marching bands.
meanings.example_cn: 我们看了有花车和游行乐队的游行。

meanings.definition: To march or walk in a public celebration or show.
meanings.example: We will parade down Main Street in our costumes for the holiday festival.
meanings.example_cn: 节日庆典上我们会穿着服装沿主街游行。

meanings.definition: To move or go by something.
meanings.example: Please pass the salt to me at the table.
meanings.example_cn: 吃饭时请把盐递给我。

meanings.definition: A ticket or paper that lets you go somewhere or do something.
meanings.example: You need a hall pass to go to the bathroom during class.
meanings.example_cn: 上课时间想去洗手间，你需要有一张出入通行证。

meanings.definition: Belonging to an earlier time and not the present.
meanings.example: Old photos show what my parents looked like in the past.
meanings.example_cn: 老照片能让我们看到我爸爸妈妈过去的样子。

meanings.definition: A small piece of material used to cover a hole or area.
meanings.example: Mom sewed a patch on the knee of my jeans.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈在我牛仔裤膝盖的地方缝了一块补丁。

meanings.definition: To fix something by putting a piece over a hole.
meanings.example: Dad will patch the hole in my jeans with a piece of fabric.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会用一块布把我牛仔裤上的洞补上。

meanings.definition: A repeated design.
meanings.example: The blanket has a colorful pattern of stars and circles.
meanings.example_cn: 这条毯子上有星星和圆圈组成的彩色图案。

meanings.definition: A repeated way something is done.
meanings.example: Every morning, Mia follows the same pattern: she gets dressed, eats breakfast, and brushes her teeth.
meanings.example_cn: 每天早上米娅都按同样的顺序：穿衣服、吃早饭、刷牙。

meanings.definition: An animal’s foot with claws.
meanings.example: The cat licked its paw after playing outside.
meanings.example_cn: 猫在外面玩完之后舔了舔自己的爪子。

meanings.definition: To touch or scratch something with an animal’s paw.
meanings.example: The kitten will paw at the ball of yarn until it unravels.
meanings.example_cn: 小猫会不停地扒那个线球，直到把它扒散。

meanings.definition: To give money for something.
meanings.example: We have to pay for our ice cream before we eat it.
meanings.example_cn: 吃冰淇淋之前我们得先付钱。

meanings.definition: A time or state of calm and no fighting.
meanings.example: After the fight, there was peace on the playground again.
meanings.example_cn: 吵架之后，操场上又恢复了平静。

meanings.definition: A smooth, shiny gem made inside an oyster.
meanings.example: She wore a pearl on a necklace to the party.
meanings.example_cn: 她戴着一条珍珠项链去参加聚会。

meanings.definition: Without any mistakes or faults.
meanings.example: Your drawing is perfect—there’s not a single mistake!
meanings.example_cn: 你的画太完美了——一个错都没有！

meanings.definition: To do or carry out something.
meanings.example: The robot can perform many tasks all by itself.
meanings.example_cn: 这个机器人可以独立完成许多任务。

meanings.definition: To act, sing, or play in front of people.
meanings.example: Our class will perform a song at the school concert.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班会在学校音乐会上表演一首歌。

meanings.definition: A liquid that smells nice and is worn on the body.
meanings.example: Mom sprayed a little perfume on her wrist before leaving the house.
meanings.example_cn: 出门前妈妈在手腕上喷了一点香水。

meanings.definition: To make something smell sweet by putting perfume on it.
meanings.example: She likes to perfume her letters so they smell nice when you open them.
meanings.example_cn: 她喜欢在信上喷香水，这样你打开的时候会闻到香味。

meanings.definition: Suggests something is possible but not certain.
meanings.example: Perhaps we can go to the park after it stops raining.
meanings.example_cn: 也许雨停之后我们可以去公园。

meanings.definition: An animal kept for fun or companionship.
meanings.example: My pet dog loves to play fetch in the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 我的宠物狗喜欢在院子里玩抛接球。

meanings.definition: To gently stroke or touch an animal.
meanings.example: Can I pet your puppy? He looks so soft!
meanings.example_cn: 我能摸摸你的小狗吗？它看起来好软！

meanings.definition: One of the colorful leaf parts of a flower.
meanings.example: Each petal on the rose was soft and bright pink.
meanings.example_cn: 玫瑰的每一片花瓣都软软的，是鲜艳的粉色。

meanings.definition: A device for talking to people far away.
meanings.example: I called my grandma on the phone to tell her about my day.
meanings.example_cn: 我给奶奶打电话，告诉她我今天过得怎么样。

meanings.definition: To call and talk to someone using a telephone.
meanings.example: I will phone my friend to invite her to my birthday party.
meanings.example_cn: 我要给朋友打电话，邀请她来参加我的生日聚会。

meanings.definition: A large musical instrument with black and white keys.
meanings.example: My sister plays songs on the piano every evening.
meanings.example_cn: 我姐姐每天晚上都在钢琴上弹曲子。

meanings.definition: To choose or select something.
meanings.example: You can pick your favorite color for the project.
meanings.example_cn: 做这个小作品时你可以挑自己最喜欢的颜色。

meanings.definition: A choice or something you select.
meanings.example: You get the first pick of the board games tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 今晚桌游你可以第一个挑。

meanings.definition: To pull or pluck something, like a flower or fruit, off a plant.
meanings.example: She likes to pick fresh apples from the tree in her backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 她喜欢从自家后院的树上摘新鲜苹果。

meanings.definition: A part or portion of something.
meanings.example: Can I have a piece of your chocolate bar?
meanings.example_cn: 我能吃一块你的巧克力吗？

meanings.definition: A stack or heap of things.
meanings.example: There was a pile of books stacked on my desk.
meanings.example_cn: 我的桌子上摞着一堆书。

meanings.definition: To stack or put things in a big heap.
meanings.example: Let’s pile all the dirty clothes into the laundry basket.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把所有脏衣服都堆进洗衣篮里吧。

meanings.definition: A person who flies an airplane.
meanings.example: The pilot greeted us before the plane took off.
meanings.example_cn: 飞机起飞前飞行员向我们打招呼。

meanings.definition: To fly or guide an airplane, boat, or other vehicle.
meanings.example: My uncle will pilot the plane on our trip to Florida.
meanings.example_cn: 我叔叔会驾驶我们去佛罗里达旅行的飞机。

meanings.definition: A small metal stick with a sharp point for fastening things.
meanings.example: Use a pin to hold the paper together.
meanings.example_cn: 用一根大头针把纸别在一起。

meanings.definition: To attach or fasten something using a pin.
meanings.example: Please pin your name tag to your shirt so everyone knows your name.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的姓名牌别在衬衫上，这样大家就知道你的名字了。

meanings.definition: A tree with long needles that stays green all year.
meanings.example: We decorated the pine tree with lights for the holidays.
meanings.example_cn: 过节时我们用彩灯装饰了松树。

meanings.definition: A tube for carrying liquid or gas.
meanings.example: Water flows through the pipe under the sink.
meanings.example_cn: 水从水槽下面的管子里流过。

meanings.definition: To carry something, like water or gas, through a tube.
meanings.example: The workers will pipe water into the new swimming pool.
meanings.example_cn: 工人会用水管把水引到新游泳池里。

meanings.definition: How high or low a sound is.
meanings.example: The singer’s voice went up to a high pitch.
meanings.example_cn: 歌手的声音升高到了很高的音调。

meanings.definition: To set up a tent.
meanings.example: Let’s pitch the tent in a flat, grassy spot.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在一块平坦的草地上搭帐篷吧。

meanings.definition: To throw something.
meanings.example: The baseball player pitched the ball quickly to the catcher.
meanings.example_cn: 棒球手快速地把球投给捕手。

meanings.definition: Feeling sorry for someone else's trouble or sadness.
meanings.example: I felt pity for the lost puppy and wanted to help.
meanings.example_cn: 我同情那只走失的小狗，想帮帮它。

meanings.definition: To feel sorry for someone.
meanings.example: I pity the lost kitten and hope someone finds her.
meanings.example_cn: 我可怜那只走失的小猫，希望有人能找到它。

meanings.definition: Something used to connect to power.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to plug in your tablet so it charges overnight.
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了给你的平板插上电，让它充一晚上。

meanings.definition: To connect things together.
meanings.example: Please plug your phone into the charger to fill the battery.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的手机插到充电器上，把电池充满。

meanings.definition: Added to.
meanings.example: You get a cookie plus a glass of milk for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 甜点你会得到一块饼干，再加一杯牛奶。

meanings.definition: Something that can make you very sick or cause death.
meanings.example: Never touch a bottle marked “poison” because it can hurt you.
meanings.example_cn: 千万不要碰标着“毒药”的瓶子，因为它会伤害你。

meanings.definition: To harm someone or something by giving them something dangerous to eat or drink.
meanings.example: Never eat strange berries because they could poison you.
meanings.example_cn: 千万不要吃陌生的浆果，它们可能有毒。

meanings.definition: Related to the North or South Pole.
meanings.example: Polar bears live in the polar regions where it is very cold and snowy.
meanings.example_cn: 北极熊住在又冷又多雪的极地地区。

meanings.definition: A long, straight stick or rod.
meanings.example: We raised the flag up the pole during the morning assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 晨会时我们把旗子升到旗杆上。

meanings.definition: A survey where people give their opinions or votes.
meanings.example: Our class took a poll to see which game everyone wanted to play.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班做了一个投票，看大家想玩哪个游戏。

meanings.definition: To ask people questions to find out what they think.
meanings.example: The teacher will poll the class to see which field trip we want.
meanings.example_cn: 老师会在班里做个调查，看我们想去哪里实地考察。

meanings.definition: A small horse.
meanings.example: I rode a gentle pony at the petting zoo.
meanings.example_cn: 我在小动物园骑了一匹温顺的小马。

meanings.definition: Music that is popular and easy to listen to.
meanings.example: My favorite pop song always makes me want to dance.
meanings.example_cn: 我最喜欢的流行歌总让我想跳舞。

meanings.definition: To burst open with a quick, small sound.
meanings.example: Let’s pop the balloons after the party is over.
meanings.example_cn: 聚会结束后我们把气球捏爆吧。

meanings.definition: A tiny hole in the skin or surface of something.
meanings.example: Sweat comes out of the tiny pores on your skin when you are hot.
meanings.example_cn: 你热的时候，汗水从皮肤上的小毛孔里冒出来。

meanings.definition: A long stick set upright.
meanings.example: We hung the sign on a wooden post by the road.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把标志牌挂在路边的一根木桩上。

meanings.definition: To put up a notice for others to see.
meanings.example: I will post my drawing on the bulletin board for everyone to see.
meanings.example_cn: 我会把我的画贴在布告栏上让大家看。

meanings.definition: To send something by mail.
meanings.example: I will post this letter to my friend tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我明天把这封信寄给我的朋友。

meanings.definition: A container used for cooking or planting.
meanings.example: We made soup in a big pot for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们用一个大锅做了汤。

meanings.definition: A unit of weight.
meanings.example: The puppy weighed just one pound when it was born.
meanings.example_cn: 这只小狗刚出生时只有一磅重。

meanings.definition: To hit something very hard.
meanings.example: We had to pound the dough with our fists to make pizza crust.
meanings.example_cn: 我们得用拳头捶面团，来做披萨饼底。

meanings.definition: To make liquid flow out.
meanings.example: Please pour the juice into my cup.
meanings.example_cn: 请把果汁倒进我的杯子里。

meanings.definition: Doing something again and again to get better.
meanings.example: You need lots of practice to play the piano well.
meanings.example_cn: 想把钢琴弹好，你需要大量练习。

meanings.definition: A usual or regular way of doing something.
meanings.example: Brushing your teeth every night is a good practice to keep them healthy.
meanings.example_cn: 每天晚上刷牙是保持牙齿健康的好习惯。

meanings.definition: To do something over and over to get better at it.
meanings.example: You need to practise the piano every day to get better.
meanings.example_cn: 想进步你就得每天练钢琴。

meanings.definition: To do something again and again so you can get better at it.
meanings.example: I practise playing the piano every day so I can get better at my songs.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天都练弹钢琴，这样我的曲子就能弹得更好。

meanings.definition: A small shellfish like a shrimp.
meanings.example: We saw a prawn swimming in the ocean at the aquarium.
