meanings.example_cn: 我们在水族馆看到一只对虾在海里游。

meanings.definition: To make something or someone ready.
meanings.example: Let’s prepare our backpacks for school tomorrow.
meanings.example_cn: 我们为明天上学把书包收拾好。

meanings.definition: A strong push or force on something.
meanings.example: The pressure in the balloon made it pop when I squeezed it.
meanings.example_cn: 我一捏，气球里的压力就让它爆了。

meanings.definition: To try to make someone do something by asking or urging them a lot.
meanings.example: Don’t pressure your friend to play if she doesn’t want to.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你的朋友不想玩，就不要逼她。

meanings.definition: A feeling of urgency or stress.
meanings.example: I felt a lot of pressure before my piano recital.
meanings.example_cn: 钢琴独奏会前我感到很大的压力。

meanings.definition: To act like something is true when it is not.
meanings.example: We pretend to be pirates when we play in the backyard.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在后院玩的时候假装自己是海盗。

meanings.definition: The act of making-believe.
meanings.example: Playing pretend is fun when we act like pirates or astronauts.
meanings.example_cn: 我们扮演海盗或宇航员的时候，过家家很好玩。

meanings.definition: To stop something from happening.
meanings.example: Wearing a helmet will help prevent injuries when you ride your bike.
meanings.example_cn: 骑自行车时戴头盔能防止受伤。

meanings.definition: How much something costs.
meanings.example: What is the price of this toy car?
meanings.example_cn: 这辆玩具车多少钱？

meanings.definition: To decide how much something will cost.
meanings.example: The store manager will price all the new toys before putting them on the shelves.
meanings.example_cn: 商店经理会给所有新玩具定价，然后再摆上货架。

meanings.definition: To put words, pictures, or designs on paper with ink or a printer.
meanings.example: I like to print my drawings with colorful markers.
meanings.example_cn: 我喜欢用彩色马克笔把我的画印出来。

meanings.definition: A picture or photo made by printing.
meanings.example: I made a colorful print of my hand with paint in art class.
meanings.example_cn: 美术课上我用颜料印了一个彩色的手掌印。

meanings.definition: A small burst of air, smoke, or breath.
meanings.example: The train let out a big puff of smoke as it started moving.
meanings.example_cn: 火车开动时冒出一大股烟。

meanings.definition: To blow out small bursts of air or smoke.
meanings.example: Watch the dragon puff smoke from his nose in the cartoon.
meanings.example_cn: 看动画片里龙从鼻子里喷烟。

meanings.definition: To make someone suffer because they did something wrong.
meanings.example: If you break the rules, the teacher might punish you by taking away recess.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你违反规则，老师可能会取消你的课间休息来惩罚你。

meanings.definition: A student.
meanings.example: Every pupil in our class gets a turn to be line leader.
meanings.example_cn: 我们班每个学生都有机会当排队队长。

meanings.definition: The black, round part in the center of your eye.
meanings.example: The doctor checked my pupil with a small flashlight.
meanings.example_cn: 医生用一个小手电筒检查了我的瞳孔。

meanings.definition: A baby dog.
meanings.example: Our new puppy likes to chew on everything!
meanings.example_cn: 我们的新小狗喜欢什么都啃！

meanings.definition: To move something to a place.
meanings.example: Please put your backpack by the door.
meanings.example_cn: 请把你的书包放在门边。

meanings.definition: To place something somewhere.
meanings.example: Please put your books on the shelf when you’re done.
meanings.example_cn: 看完书请把书放回架子上。

meanings.definition: A line of people or vehicles waiting for their turn.
meanings.example: We stood in a long queue waiting to buy tickets for the movie.
meanings.example_cn: 我们排了很长的队等着买电影票。

meanings.definition: To wait in line for your turn.
meanings.example: We must queue outside the classroom and wait for the teacher.
meanings.example_cn: 我们必须在教室外面排队等老师。

meanings.definition: Moving fast or happening in a short time.
meanings.example: The rabbit was so quick, it dashed across the yard in seconds.
meanings.example_cn: 兔子太快了，几秒钟就窜过了院子。

meanings.definition: Able to understand or learn things fast.
meanings.example: She is quick to solve math problems in class.
meanings.example_cn: 她在课堂上解数学题很快。

meanings.definition: A bar used as a barrier or support.
meanings.example: Hold onto the rail so you don’t slip on the stairs.
meanings.example_cn: 扶着栏杆，这样你在楼梯上就不会滑倒。

meanings.definition: Having a lot of rain.
meanings.example: It was a rainy day, so we played games inside.
meanings.example_cn: 这是个下雨天，所以我们在屋里玩游戏。

meanings.definition: A sloped surface that joins two levels.
meanings.example: The ramp helps people in wheelchairs get into the building.
meanings.example_cn: 坡道帮助坐轮椅的人进入大楼。

meanings.definition: A position in a group or organization.
meanings.example: He got the highest rank in his karate class.
meanings.example_cn: 他在空手道班里拿到了最高等级。

meanings.definition: To put things or people in order from best to worst, or by level.
meanings.example: Let’s rank the flavors of ice cream from best to least favorite.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把冰淇淋口味从最喜欢到最不喜欢排个序吧。

meanings.definition: A large black bird similar to a crow.
meanings.example: A raven sat in the tall tree and cawed loudly.
meanings.example_cn: 一只渡鸦坐在高高的树上，呱呱地叫。

meanings.definition: Not cooked.
meanings.example: You can eat carrots raw or cook them for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 胡萝卜可以生吃，也可以煮了当晚饭。

meanings.definition: Not experienced or new to something.
meanings.example: He was raw at playing chess, but he learned quickly with practice.
meanings.example_cn: 他刚开始下国际象棋还很生，但练着练着就学快了。

meanings.definition: In its natural state, not cooked or changed.
meanings.example: Carrots are crunchy and tasty when they’re raw.
meanings.example_cn: 胡萝卜生吃时又脆又好吃。

meanings.definition: The back part of something.
meanings.example: The puppy wagged its tail at the rear of the car.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗在汽车后面摇着尾巴。

meanings.definition: To take care of and raise children as they grow up.
meanings.example: It takes a lot of patience to rear a puppy and teach it new tricks.
meanings.example_cn: 养一只小狗并教它新把戏需要很多耐心。

meanings.definition: To reuse materials by making them into something new.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to recycle your plastic bottles after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后别忘了回收你的塑料瓶。

meanings.definition: To show an image on a surface, like a mirror.
meanings.example: The lake was so still it could reflect the trees like a mirror.
meanings.example_cn: 湖面静得像镜子一样，能倒映出树木。

meanings.definition: To think quietly and carefully about something.
meanings.example: After the game, we took time to reflect on what went well and what we could improve.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束后，我们花时间回想哪些做得好、哪些可以改进。

meanings.definition: To feel sorry about something that happened.
meanings.example: I regret not studying harder for the test.
meanings.example_cn: 我后悔没有为考试更努力学习。

meanings.definition: A sad or disappointed feeling about something you did or did not do.
meanings.example: My biggest regret was not studying for the test.
meanings.example_cn: 我最大的遗憾就是没有为考试复习。

meanings.definition: To become calm or less tense.
meanings.example: Let’s relax by reading a book on the couch.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在沙发上看本书放松一下吧。

meanings.definition: To keep something in your mind.
meanings.example: Remember to bring your lunch to school tomorrow!
meanings.example_cn: 明天上学记得带午饭！

meanings.definition: To fix something that is broken.
meanings.example: Dad will repair my bike so I can ride it again.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸会修好我的自行车，这样我又能骑了。

meanings.definition: The act of fixing something that is broken.
meanings.example: The repair to my bike’s chain was quick and easy.
meanings.example_cn: 我自行车链条的修理又快又简单。

meanings.definition: To do or say something again.
meanings.example: Repeat the words after me to practice your spelling.
meanings.example_cn: 跟着我重复这些词，练习拼写。

meanings.definition: Something that happens or is done again.
meanings.example: This song is so good, I want to listen to it on repeat!
meanings.example_cn: 这首歌太好听了，我想单曲循环！

meanings.definition: To save someone from danger.
meanings.example: The lifeguard jumped into the pool to rescue the boy who was struggling to swim.
meanings.example_cn: 救生员跳进泳池，营救那个游泳时快要呛水、拼命挣扎的男孩。

meanings.definition: The act of saving someone or something from danger.
meanings.example: The firefighters’ rescue of the kitten from the tree made the news.
meanings.example_cn: 消防员把小猫从树上救下来的事上了新闻。

meanings.definition: A feeling of admiration or regard.
meanings.example: We should always show respect to our teachers and classmates.
meanings.example_cn: 我们应该一直尊重老师和同学。

meanings.definition: To treat them well.
meanings.example: It’s important to respect your classmates and listen when they talk.
meanings.example_cn: 尊重同学、在他们说话时认真听很重要。

meanings.definition: To admire someone.
meanings.example: We respect our teacher by listening carefully when she talks.
meanings.example_cn: 我们认真听老师讲话，以此表达对她的尊重。

meanings.definition: A period of relaxing, sleeping, or taking a break.
meanings.example: I took a short rest after playing outside all afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 玩了一下午之后，我休息了一小会儿。

meanings.definition: To stop working or moving so you can relax.
meanings.example: After soccer practice, I need to rest before doing my homework.
meanings.example_cn: 足球训练之后，我得先休息一下再做作业。

meanings.definition: A prize given for good behavior or work.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a reward for helping clean the house.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈因为我帮忙打扫房子给了我奖励。

meanings.definition: To give a prize or treat for something good that was done.
meanings.example: Mom promised to reward us with ice cream if we cleaned the garage.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈答应如果我们打扫车库，就奖励我们冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: To sit on and be carried by a vehicle or animal.
meanings.example: We will ride our bikes to the park this afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 今天下午我们骑自行车去公园。

meanings.definition: A trip or journey in a car, bus, or other vehicle.
meanings.example: The roller coaster was the best ride at the amusement park.
meanings.example_cn: 过山车是游乐园里最棒的游乐项目。

meanings.definition: The chance that something bad might happen.
meanings.example: There’s a risk of falling if you climb too high.
meanings.example_cn: 你爬得太高就有摔下来的风险。

meanings.definition: To do something that might be dangerous or cause harm.
meanings.example: Don’t risk running on the slippery floor—you might fall.
meanings.example_cn: 别在湿滑的地板上跑——你可能会摔倒。

meanings.definition: To cook food in an oven.
meanings.example: We will roast marshmallows over the campfire tonight.
meanings.example_cn: 今晚我们会在篝火上烤棉花糖。

meanings.definition: Cooked by using dry heat, usually in an oven.
meanings.example: We had roast chicken for dinner, and it was cooked perfectly in the oven.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们吃了烤鸡，在烤箱里烤得刚刚好。

meanings.definition: A piece of meat that is cooked in an oven.
meanings.example: We had a delicious roast for dinner with potatoes and carrots.
meanings.example_cn: 晚餐我们吃了一块美味的烤肉，配土豆和胡萝卜。

meanings.definition: A machine that can do tasks automatically.
meanings.example: The robot helped clean up the toys after playtime.
meanings.example_cn: 玩耍时间结束后，机器人帮忙收拾玩具。

meanings.definition: Thick, strong string made by twisting fibers together.
meanings.example: We used a rope to tie up the tent during our camping trip.
meanings.example_cn: 露营时我们用绳子把帐篷固定好。

meanings.definition: To tie or fasten with a rope.
meanings.example: Let’s rope the boxes together so they don’t fall off the cart.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把箱子捆在一起，免得从推车上掉下来。

meanings.definition: A prickly bush with pretty, often fragrant flowers.
meanings.example: A red rose grew in the garden and smelled wonderful.
meanings.example_cn: 花园里长着一朵红玫瑰，闻起来香极了。

meanings.definition: To turn around a center point.
meanings.example: The Earth will rotate once every day.
meanings.example_cn: 地球每天自转一圈。

meanings.definition: Shaped like a circle or ball.
meanings.example: The playground had a round sandbox that looked like a giant circle.
meanings.example_cn: 操场上有一个圆形沙坑，看起来像一个大圆圈。

meanings.definition: Moving in a circle or all the way around something.
meanings.example: We marched round the playground during the parade.
meanings.example_cn: 游行时我们绕着操场走圈。

meanings.definition: To make something round in shape.
meanings.example: We will round the corners of the table so they aren’t sharp.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把桌角弄圆，这样就不会扎人。

meanings.definition: The way or path taken to get somewhere.
meanings.example: We took the fastest route to get to grandma’s house.
meanings.example_cn: 我们走最快的路去奶奶家。

meanings.definition: To send or guide along a certain path.
meanings.example: The coach will route the runners along the safest path in the park.
meanings.example_cn: 教练会让跑步者沿公园里最安全的路线跑。

meanings.definition: Things or people arranged in a straight line horizontally.
meanings.example: We sat in the front row at the school assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 学校集会时我们坐在前排。

meanings.definition: A loud argument or fight.
meanings.example: There was a loud row in the hallway when the two classmates argued.
meanings.example_cn: 两个同学吵架时，走廊里响起了大声的争吵。

meanings.definition: To move a boat forward using oars.
meanings.example: We learned how to row the boat across the lake at camp.
meanings.example_cn: 露营时我们学会了怎么把船划过湖。

meanings.definition: An instruction or law that must be followed.
meanings.example: There’s a rule that says you must raise your hand before speaking.
meanings.example_cn: 有一条规则说，说话前必须先举手。

meanings.definition: To be in charge of or control something.
meanings.example: The king will rule the land and make important decisions.
meanings.example_cn: 国王会统治这个国家，并做重要的决定。

meanings.definition: To travel on water in a boat with sails.
meanings.example: We will sail across the lake in a small boat this afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 今天下午我们乘小船划过湖。

meanings.definition: A trip or journey in a boat, especially when you travel smoothly on the water.
meanings.example: We went for a relaxing sail on the lake last weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 上周末我们在湖上惬意地航行了一圈。

meanings.definition: A piece of fabric on a boat that catches wind to move it.
meanings.example: The boat’s white sail filled with wind and moved us across the lake.
meanings.example_cn: 船的白帆兜满了风，载着我们划过湖面。

meanings.definition: When goods are exchanged for money.
meanings.example: There’s a sale at the toy store, so everything costs less today.
meanings.example_cn: 玩具店在打折，所以今天所有东西都更便宜。

meanings.definition: Tasting of or containing salt.
meanings.example: The popcorn tasted very salty because of all the butter.
meanings.example_cn: 爆米花因为放了很多黄油，吃起来很咸。

meanings.definition: To meet someone’s needs.
meanings.example: A sandwich and an apple will satisfy my hunger at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午餐一个三明治加一个苹果就能让我不饿了。

meanings.definition: To make someone happy by giving them what they want or need.
meanings.example: A big bowl of ice cream will satisfy my sweet tooth.
meanings.example_cn: 一大碗冰淇淋能满足我想吃甜食的欲望。

meanings.definition: To protect from harm or loss.
meanings.example: She helped save her friend by catching him before he fell.
meanings.example_cn: 在朋友摔倒之前，她一把扶住他，救下了朋友。

meanings.definition: The act of stopping something bad from happening, like catching a ball in sports.
meanings.example: The goalie made an amazing save and stopped the ball from going into the net.
meanings.example_cn: 守门员做出了一个精彩的扑救，挡住了进门的球。

meanings.definition: To keep something in a safe place so you can use it later.
meanings.example: Always save your work on the computer so you don’t lose it.
meanings.example_cn: 在电脑上一定要随时保存，免得弄丢。

meanings.definition: To make someone suddenly afraid.
meanings.example: The loud thunder can scare our puppy.
meanings.example_cn: 响雷会吓到我们的小狗。

meanings.definition: A sudden moment when you feel frightened.
meanings.example: That loud noise gave me a real scare last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚那声巨响真把我吓了一跳。

meanings.definition: A piece of cloth worn around the neck.
meanings.example: I wore a warm scarf around my neck on the cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷时我在脖子上围了一条暖和的围巾。

meanings.definition: Causing someone to feel fear.
meanings.example: That movie was so scary, I had to cover my eyes!
meanings.example_cn: 那部电影太吓人了，我不得不捂住眼睛！

meanings.definition: A smell, often a nice one.
meanings.example: The scent of cookies baking made my mouth water.
meanings.example_cn: 烤饼干的香味让我流口水。

meanings.definition: To smell something or notice its smell.
meanings.example: I could scent the cookies baking as soon as I came home.
meanings.example_cn: 我一回到家就闻到了烤饼干的香味。

meanings.definition: A deep spoon for serving or picking up things.
meanings.example: Use the scoop to put ice cream in your bowl.
meanings.example_cn: 用勺子把冰淇淋舀到你的碗里。

meanings.definition: To pick up or take out something using a scoop or spoon.
meanings.example: I will scoop some ice cream into your bowl.
meanings.example_cn: 我给你的碗里舀一些冰淇淋。

meanings.definition: The range or area that something covers.
meanings.example: The scope of our project is to learn about planets.
meanings.example_cn: 我们这个项目的范围是了解行星。

meanings.definition: To rub or mark with something sharp.
meanings.example: My cat likes to scratch the couch with her claws.
meanings.example_cn: 我的猫喜欢用爪子抓沙发。

meanings.definition: A line or mark made by scraping or rubbing something sharp.
meanings.example: There’s a scratch on my knee from where I fell off my bike.
meanings.example_cn: 我从自行车上摔下来，膝盖上有一道刮痕。

meanings.definition: Something made for sitting on.
meanings.example: I saved a seat for you next to me.
meanings.example_cn: 我在我旁边给你留了个座位。

meanings.definition: To give someone a place to sit.
meanings.example: The usher will seat us near the front for the play.
meanings.example_cn: 引座员会把我们安排在靠近前面的位置看戏。

meanings.definition: To choose one thing or person from a group.
meanings.example: Please select your favorite flavor of ice cream.
meanings.example_cn: 请挑选你最喜欢的冰淇淋口味。

meanings.definition: A person’s own identity or sense of who they are.
meanings.example: It’s important to take care of your self and be kind to others.
meanings.example_cn: 照顾好自己、对别人友善很重要。

meanings.definition: To exchange something for money.
meanings.example: We will sell lemonade at our stand to raise money for charity.
meanings.example_cn: 我们会在小摊上卖柠檬水，为慈善筹款。

meanings.definition: Any of the five ways your body understands the world, like sight or touch.
meanings.example: My sense of smell helps me know when cookies are baking.
meanings.example_cn: 我的嗅觉能让我知道什么时候在烤饼干。

meanings.definition: To notice or become aware of something.
meanings.example: I can sense when my dog is feeling sad.
meanings.example_cn: 我能感觉到我的狗什么时候难过。

meanings.definition: A dark shape made when something blocks light.
meanings.example: My shadow followed me as I walked in the sunlight.
meanings.example_cn: 我在阳光下走路时，影子跟着我。

meanings.definition: To secretly follow someone.
meanings.example: A detective might shadow someone to see where they go.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探可能会跟踪某人，看他去哪里。

meanings.definition: A feeling of guilt.
meanings.example: He felt shame after breaking the vase and not telling the truth.
meanings.example_cn: 打碎花瓶又没说实话之后，他感到羞愧。

meanings.definition: To make someone feel embarrassed or bad about what they did.
meanings.example: Don’t shame someone for making a mistake; everyone messes up sometimes.
meanings.example_cn: 不要因为别人犯错就羞辱他；谁都有搞砸的时候。

meanings.definition: A feeling of embarrassment.
meanings.example: I felt a little shame when I spilled juice on the carpet in front of everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 当着所有人的面把果汁洒在地毯上，我有点不好意思。

meanings.definition: The form or outline of something.
meanings.example: The cookie cutter makes the dough into the shape of a star.
meanings.example_cn: 饼干模子把面团压成星星的形状。

meanings.definition: To form or mold something into a certain look.
meanings.example: Let’s shape the clay into a funny animal.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把黏土捏成一只好玩的动物吧。

meanings.definition: To give some of what you have to others.
meanings.example: Remember to share your crayons with your friends.
meanings.example_cn: 记得和朋友分享你的蜡笔。

meanings.definition: A part or piece that belongs to someone.
meanings.example: I had my share of pizza and let my brother have the last piece.
meanings.example_cn: 我吃了自己那份披萨，把最后一块留给弟弟。

meanings.definition: A large piece of fabric for a bed
meanings.example: I put a clean sheet on my bed every week.
meanings.example_cn: 我每周都在床上换一张干净的床单。

meanings.definition: A single piece of paper.
meanings.example: Please hand me a sheet of paper for my drawing.
meanings.example_cn: 请递给我一张纸来画画。

meanings.definition: A thin, flat piece of something.
meanings.example: The baker placed a sheet of dough on the table to make cookies.
meanings.example_cn: 面包师把一片擀好的面团放在桌上做饼干。

meanings.definition: A flat board to hold things.
meanings.example: Put your books back on the shelf when you’re done reading.
meanings.example_cn: 看完书把书放回架子上。

meanings.definition: To give off light or be bright.
meanings.example: The sun will shine brightly in the sky today.
meanings.example_cn: 今天太阳会在天空中明亮地照耀。

meanings.definition: Bright light.
meanings.example: The car had a nice shine after Dad washed and polished it.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸洗完并打了蜡之后，车闪闪发亮。

meanings.definition: Bright and glossy.
meanings.example: Her new shoes are so shiny, they sparkle in the light.
meanings.example_cn: 她的新鞋亮闪闪的，在光线下闪闪发光。

meanings.definition: To shake a little, usually from cold or fear.
meanings.example: I always shiver when I get out of the pool on a cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷时我从泳池出来总会发抖。

meanings.definition: A small shake or tremble, often from being cold or scared.
meanings.example: He gave a little shiver when he stepped into the cold pool.
meanings.example_cn: 他走进冷水池时轻轻打了个哆嗦。

meanings.definition: A sudden and surprising event.
meanings.example: It was a shock to see snow falling in April.
meanings.example_cn: 四月看到下雪真让人震惊。

meanings.definition: To surprise someone in a strong or sudden way.
meanings.example: It may shock you to know that I’ve never eaten sushi!
meanings.example_cn: 告诉你我从没吃过寿司，可能会吓你一跳！

meanings.definition: A strong, sudden, and unpleasant feeling.
meanings.example: It was a shock to see snow in May!
meanings.example_cn: 五月看到雪真让人震惊！

meanings.definition: A try or attempt at doing something.
meanings.example: He took a shot at making the basketball, but it bounced off the rim.
meanings.example_cn: 他试着投那个篮球，但球弹筐而出。

meanings.definition: The part of the body where the arm attaches.
meanings.example: I carried my backpack on my shoulder as I walked to school.
meanings.example_cn: 我走路上学的时候把书包挎在肩上。

meanings.definition: To carry something by resting it on your shoulder.
meanings.example: Let me shoulder your backpack so you don’t get tired on the hike.
meanings.example_cn: 我来帮你背包吧，这样你徒步时就不会累。

meanings.definition: When water sprays from above so you can wash your body.
meanings.example: I take a shower every night before bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我每天晚上睡觉前都冲澡。

meanings.definition: To wash your body while standing under running water.
meanings.example: I like to shower after playing outside because it makes me feel fresh.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面玩完之后我喜欢冲个澡，这样感觉清爽。

meanings.definition: A short time when it rains.
meanings.example: We had a quick shower of rain right before recess.
meanings.example_cn: 课间休息前我们刚遇了一阵急雨。

meanings.definition: A small torn or cut piece.
meanings.example: There was a shred of paper left on my desk after I finished my project.
meanings.example_cn: 做完作品后，我的桌上还留着一小片碎纸。

meanings.definition: To tear something into thin, small pieces.
meanings.example: Let’s shred the old papers before we throw them away.
meanings.example_cn: 扔掉旧文件之前我们先把它们碎掉。

meanings.definition: Feeling unwell or experiencing illness.
meanings.example: I stayed home from school because I felt sick.
meanings.example_cn: 我感觉不舒服，所以没去上学待在家里。

meanings.definition: Very unpleasant or disgusting.
meanings.example: The smell from the garbage can was so sick I had to hold my nose.
meanings.example_cn: 垃圾桶的味道太恶心了，我只好捂住鼻子。

meanings.definition: To let out a long breath, often to show sadness or relief.
meanings.example: She let out a big sigh when she finished her homework.
meanings.example_cn: 做完作业之后她长长地叹了口气。

meanings.definition: A long, slow breath that you can hear, often showing sadness or relief.
meanings.example: She let out a big sigh when she finished her homework.
meanings.example_cn: 做完作业之后她长长地叹了口气。

meanings.definition: A mark, gesture, or symbol that gives information.
meanings.example: The stop sign tells cars where to stop.
meanings.example_cn: 停止标志告诉汽车该在哪里停。

meanings.definition: To write your name to show you agree or approve.
meanings.example: Please sign your name at the bottom of the permission slip.
meanings.example_cn: 请在同意书的底部签上你的名字。

meanings.definition: A sound or gesture used to send a message.
meanings.example: Mom gave me a signal to come inside for dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈给了我一个信号，叫我进屋吃晚饭。

meanings.definition: To make a sign or motion to give information or instructions.
meanings.example: Raise your hand to signal the teacher if you need help.
meanings.example_cn: 需要帮助时举手示意老师。

meanings.definition: The state of being completely quiet.
meanings.example: There was complete silence in the library.
meanings.example_cn: 图书馆里一片寂静。

meanings.definition: To make someone or something quiet.
meanings.example: The principal asked everyone to silence their phones during the assembly.
meanings.example_cn: 校长让大家在集会时把手机调成静音。

meanings.definition: A soft, shiny fabric made by silkworms.
meanings.example: Her dress was made of smooth, shiny silk.
meanings.example_cn: 她的裙子是用光滑发亮的丝绸做的。

meanings.definition: To make music with your voice.
meanings.example: We love to sing songs together in music class.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在音乐课上喜欢一起唱歌。

meanings.definition: To drink a little bit at a time.
meanings.example: Take a small sip of your hot chocolate so you don’t burn your tongue.
meanings.example_cn: 热巧克力小口抿，别烫了舌头。

meanings.definition: A small drink or mouthful of something.
meanings.example: She took a small sip of lemonade and smiled.
meanings.example_cn: 她小小地喝了一口柠檬水，笑了。

meanings.definition: How big or small something is.
meanings.example: What size shoes do you wear?
meanings.example_cn: 你穿多大码的鞋？

meanings.definition: To sort or arrange things based on how big or small they are.
meanings.example: Let’s size the puppies from smallest to biggest.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把小狗从最小到最大排个序吧。

meanings.definition: A boot with a blade or wheels for moving on ice or hard surfaces.
meanings.example: I wear my roller skates to go fast at the park.
meanings.example_cn: 我穿轮滑鞋在公园里滑得很快。

meanings.definition: To move smoothly over a surface using skates.
meanings.example: We love to skate on the ice rink in winter.
meanings.example_cn: 冬天我们喜欢在滑冰场上滑冰。

meanings.definition: A long, flat piece worn on the feet to slide over snow.
meanings.example: We rented skis to go down the snowy mountain.
meanings.example_cn: 我们租了滑雪板，要从雪山上滑下来。

meanings.definition: To glide or travel over snow using skis.
meanings.example: We are going to ski down the snowy hill this weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 这个周末我们要从雪坡上滑雪下来。

meanings.definition: The ability to do something well.
meanings.example: Drawing animals is my best skill.
meanings.example_cn: 画动物是我最拿手的本领。

meanings.definition: Clothing that hangs from the waist.
meanings.example: She wore a blue skirt with flowers on it.
meanings.example_cn: 她穿了一条带花的蓝色裙子。

meanings.definition: To go around the edge or border of something.
meanings.example: Let’s skirt the muddy puddle so our shoes stay clean.
meanings.example_cn: 我们绕过泥水坑走，这样鞋就干净了。

meanings.definition: A thin, flat piece cut from something.
meanings.example: Can I have one slice of pizza, please?
meanings.example_cn: 请给我一片披萨好吗？

meanings.definition: To cut something into thin pieces.
meanings.example: Please slice the apples so we can share them.
meanings.example_cn: 请把苹果切开，这样我们可以分着吃。

meanings.definition: To move smoothly along a surface.
meanings.example: Be careful not to slide on the icy sidewalk.
meanings.example_cn: 小心别在结冰的人行道上滑倒。

meanings.definition: A smooth track for sliding down.
meanings.example: The playground slide is my favorite because it’s so tall and fast.
meanings.example_cn: 操场滑梯是我最喜欢的，因为它又高又快。

meanings.definition: A fall when you slip.
meanings.example: After the rain, Tim went for a run and took a slide in the wet grass.
meanings.example_cn: 下雨后蒂姆去跑步，在湿草地上滑了一跤。

meanings.definition: Thick, wet, sticky stuff.
meanings.example: We made green slime in science class, and it was sticky and fun to play with.
meanings.example_cn: 科学课上我们做了绿色的水晶泥，黏糊糊的很好玩。

meanings.definition: To slide by accident.
meanings.example: Don’t run by the pool, or you might slip and fall.
meanings.example_cn: 别在泳池边跑，不然你可能滑倒摔跤。

meanings.definition: A small accident where you slide by mistake.
meanings.example: Her slip on the icy sidewalk made her giggle.
meanings.example_cn: 她在结冰的人行道上滑了一下，咯咯地笑了。

meanings.definition: Laziness.
meanings.example: A sloth moves very slowly and spends most of its time sleeping in trees.
meanings.example_cn: 树懒动得非常慢，大部分时间都在树上睡觉。

meanings.definition: An animal that moves very slowly and spends most of its time in trees.
meanings.example: The sloth moved so slowly through the trees that it looked like it was barely moving.
meanings.example_cn: 树懒在树间动得那么慢，看起来几乎没在动。

meanings.definition: Clever.
meanings.example: She is very smart and always gets good grades in math.
meanings.example_cn: 她非常聪明，数学总是拿好成绩。

meanings.definition: Looking neat and tidy.
meanings.example: You look very smart in your new school uniform!
meanings.example_cn: 你穿新校服看起来真精神！

meanings.definition: The visible gas from something burning.
meanings.example: We saw smoke rising from the chimney on a cold day.
meanings.example_cn: 天冷时我们看到烟囱冒出烟。

meanings.definition: Full of smoke.
meanings.example: The kitchen got smoky when Dad burned the toast.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸把面包烤糊了，厨房里都是烟。

meanings.definition: A small amount of food eaten between meals.
meanings.example: I like to have a fruit snack after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我喜欢吃一点水果当零食。

meanings.definition: To eat a small, light meal between regular meals.
meanings.example: I like to snack on fruit between lunch and dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭和晚饭之间我喜欢吃点水果当零食。

meanings.definition: To move quietly and secretly.
meanings.example: Let’s sneak quietly past the sleeping dog so we don’t wake him up.
meanings.example_cn: 我们悄悄从睡着的狗旁边溜过去，别把它吵醒。

meanings.definition: A person who moves quietly and secretly.
meanings.example: The sneak tiptoed across the room so no one would hear him.
meanings.example_cn: 那个偷偷摸摸的人踮着脚穿过房间，怕被人听见。

meanings.definition: To smell by breathing in through the nose.
meanings.example: The puppy likes to sniff everything in the yard.
meanings.example_cn: 小狗喜欢闻院子里的每一样东西。

meanings.definition: The act of smelling something by quickly breathing in through your nose.
meanings.example: One sniff of the cookies baking made my mouth water.
meanings.example_cn: 一闻见烤饼干的香味我就流口水。

meanings.definition: To breathe noisily while sleeping.
meanings.example: Dad sometimes snores loudly when he sleeps.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸睡觉有时会大声打呼噜。

meanings.definition: The loud sound some people make while sleeping.
meanings.example: Dad’s snore was so loud I could hear it from my room.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸的呼噜声大得我在自己房间都能听见。

meanings.definition: Covered with snow.
meanings.example: It was a snowy day, so we built a snowman outside.
meanings.example_cn: 这是个下雪天，所以我们在外面堆了个雪人。

meanings.definition: To get very wet.
meanings.example: My socks will soak up water if I step in a puddle.
meanings.example_cn: 如果我踩进水坑，袜子就会吸透水。

meanings.definition: The act of getting something very wet by leaving it in water.
meanings.example: After the muddy soccer game, my socks needed a good soak.
meanings.example_cn: 踢完那场满是泥的足球赛后，我的袜子得好好泡一泡。

meanings.definition: To put something in water or another liquid so it gets very wet.
meanings.example: Let’s soak the dirty dishes in the sink before washing them.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把脏碗碟先泡在水槽里，再洗。

meanings.definition: Something you use to wash and clean.
meanings.example: Use soap and water to wash your hands before dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭前用肥皂和水洗手。

meanings.definition: To wash or rub with soap to get clean.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to soap your hands before rinsing them.
meanings.example_cn: 冲水之前别忘了用肥皂搓手。

meanings.definition: To cry hard with short breaths.
meanings.example: She began to sob when she lost her favorite toy.
meanings.example_cn: 弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，她开始抽泣。

meanings.definition: A noisy, shaking cry, often when you are very sad.
meanings.example: A quiet sob came from my sister when she lost her favorite toy.
meanings.example_cn: 弄丢了最喜欢的玩具，我妹妹发出了轻轻的啜泣声。

meanings.definition: A piece of clothing worn on your foot.
meanings.example: I can’t find the matching sock for my left foot.
meanings.example_cn: 我找不到左脚那只配对的袜子了。

meanings.definition: A fizzy, bubbly drink.
meanings.example: We had a cold soda with our pizza at lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭我们配披萨喝了一杯冰汽水。

meanings.definition: A long, soft seat for more than one person.
meanings.example: We sat together on the sofa to watch a movie.
meanings.example_cn: 我们一起坐在沙发上看电影。

meanings.definition: The ground where plants grow.
meanings.example: Plants need rich soil to grow healthy and strong.
meanings.example_cn: 植物需要肥沃的土壤才能长得健康茁壮。

meanings.definition: To make something dirty.
meanings.example: Please take off your shoes so you don’t soil the clean floor.
meanings.example_cn: 请脱鞋，免得把干净的地板踩脏。

meanings.definition: A boy or male child.
meanings.example: Mom and Dad have one son and one daughter.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸妈妈有一个儿子和一个女儿。

meanings.definition: Painful or hurting.
meanings.example: My legs are sore after running in gym class.
meanings.example_cn: 体育课跑完步，我的腿好酸。

meanings.definition: A spot on your body that hurts.
meanings.example: I have a sore on my knee from falling off my bike.
meanings.example_cn: 我从自行车上摔下来，膝盖上有个疼的地方。

meanings.definition: Feeling bad or regretful.
meanings.example: I’m sorry I broke your pencil.
meanings.example_cn: 对不起，我把你的铅笔弄坏了。

meanings.definition: A kind or type of something.
meanings.example: Let’s put each sort of block in a different bin.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把每种积木放进不同的箱子里。

meanings.definition: To arrange things into groups based on type.
meanings.example: Let’s sort the buttons by color before we start the craft.
meanings.example_cn: 做手工之前我们先按颜色把纽扣分好。

meanings.definition: Tasting acidic, like a lemon.
meanings.example: The lemonade was too sour and made my face pucker.
meanings.example_cn: 柠檬水太酸了，酸得我脸都皱起来。

meanings.definition: Unfriendly, grumpy, or easily annoyed.
meanings.example: He gave me a sour look when I took the last cookie.
meanings.example_cn: 我拿走最后一块饼干时，他冲我板着脸。

meanings.definition: The direction opposite north.
meanings.example: We drove south to visit the beach for our vacation.
meanings.example_cn: 我们往南开去度假，去看海滩。

meanings.definition: Something is getting worse or going badly.
meanings.example: Our project started off well, but everything went south when the computer crashed.
meanings.example_cn: 我们的项目一开始进展顺利，但是电脑死机后，所有事情都变糟了。

meanings.definition: A small bit of fire or electricity.
meanings.example: A spark jumped from the campfire when we added more wood.
meanings.example_cn: 我们往篝火里加木柴时，溅出了一颗火星。

meanings.definition: To make small flashes of light.
meanings.example: The wires touched and began to spark in the dark.
meanings.example_cn: 电线碰在一起，在黑暗中开始冒火花。

meanings.definition: To start something happening.
meanings.example: Hearing the exciting news sparked my interest in joining the science club.
meanings.example_cn: 听到这个激动人心的消息，激起了我参加科学社团的兴趣。

meanings.definition: How fast something moves.
meanings.example: The race car zoomed by at an amazing speed.
meanings.example_cn: 赛车以惊人的速度呼啸而过。

meanings.definition: To move fast or go quickly.
meanings.example: The rabbit will speed across the yard when it hears a loud noise.
meanings.example_cn: 兔子听到巨响时会飞快地窜过院子。

meanings.definition: To say or write the letters of a word in the right order.
meanings.example: Can you spell your name out loud for the teacher?
meanings.example_cn: 你能大声把自己的名字拼给老师听吗？

meanings.definition: A magic word or action that causes something special to happen.
meanings.example: The wizard cast a spell to make the frog talk.
meanings.example_cn: 巫师施了一个咒语，让青蛙开口说话。

meanings.definition: To use money to buy things.
meanings.example: I want to spend my allowance on a new toy.
meanings.example_cn: 我想把零花钱花在一个新玩具上。

meanings.definition: To use your time for something.
meanings.example: We like to spend time together playing board games on weekends.
meanings.example_cn: 我们喜欢在周末一起玩桌面游戏，共度欢乐时光。

meanings.definition: Having a strong flavor from spices.
meanings.example: That salsa is too spicy for me to eat.
meanings.example_cn: 那个莎莎酱对我来说太辣了。

meanings.definition: To accidentally let liquid flow out.
meanings.example: Be careful not to spill your juice on the carpet.
meanings.example_cn: 小心别把果汁洒在地毯上。

meanings.definition: The act of something falling out.
meanings.example: There was a big spill on the kitchen floor after I dropped my juice.
meanings.example_cn: 我把果汁弄掉之后，厨房地上洒了一大片。

meanings.definition: To turn around quickly.
meanings.example: Let’s spin around in circles and see who gets dizzy first.
meanings.example_cn: 我们原地转圈，看谁先晕。

meanings.definition: A fast turning movement.
meanings.example: Let’s give the bottle a spin and see who goes next.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把瓶子转一下，看接下来轮到谁。

meanings.definition: To make thread by twisting fibers together.
meanings.example: Spiders spin webs to catch their food.
meanings.example_cn: 蜘蛛织网来捕捉食物。

meanings.definition: Liquid sent through the air in tiny drops.
meanings.example: Mom used a spray to water all the plants at once.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈用喷雾一次性给所有植物浇水。

meanings.definition: To scatter tiny drops of liquid around.
meanings.example: Let’s spray the plants with water to help them grow.
meanings.example_cn: 我们给植物喷点水，帮它们长大。

meanings.definition: To cover a bigger area.
meanings.example: We spread the glue over the paper so the glitter would stick everywhere.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把胶水涂满纸，这样亮片就能粘得到处都是。

meanings.definition: How far something goes across an area.
meanings.example: The spread of the paint on the wall made the whole room look brighter.
meanings.example_cn: 墙上颜料铺开后，整个房间都显得更亮了。

meanings.definition: To move out in all directions.
meanings.example: The smell of fresh cookies spread through the whole house.
meanings.example_cn: 新烤饼干的香味弥漫了整个屋子。

meanings.definition: Someone who secretly collects information.
meanings.example: The story was about a spy who had many clever disguises.
meanings.example_cn: 这个故事讲的是一个有许多巧妙伪装的间谍。

meanings.definition: To watch someone or something secretly.
meanings.example: We tried to spy on the birds without scaring them away.
meanings.example_cn: 我们想偷偷观察鸟，又不把它们吓跑。

meanings.definition: A shape with four equal sides and four right angles.
meanings.example: The children drew a square on the sidewalk with chalk.
meanings.example_cn: 孩子们用粉笔在人行道上画了一个正方形。

meanings.definition: A shape with four sides that are all the same length.
meanings.example: Draw a square box and color it blue.
meanings.example_cn: 画一个正方形盒子，涂成蓝色。

meanings.definition: To make something straight, even, or right-angled.
meanings.example: Can you square the corners of the paper so it fits neatly in the folder?
meanings.example_cn: 你能把纸的角修整齐，让它刚好放进文件夹吗？

meanings.definition: To begin.
meanings.example: Let’s start the race when everyone is ready.
meanings.example_cn: 大家都准备好了我们就开始比赛。

meanings.definition: To make something begin.
meanings.example: Let’s start the game when everyone is ready.
meanings.example_cn: 大家都准备好了我们就开始游戏。

meanings.definition: The beginning of something.
meanings.example: The start of the race was very exciting.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛的开始非常激动人心。

meanings.definition: To come to an end.
meanings.example: The rain will stop soon, and we can go outside.
meanings.example_cn: 雨很快就会停，我们就可以到外面去玩啦。

meanings.definition: To make someone or something not do something.
meanings.example: Mom stopped me from eating too many cookies before dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 妈妈不让我在晚饭前吃太多饼干。

meanings.definition: A place where you get off or on (bus or train stop).
meanings.example: We waited at the bus stop for the school bus to arrive.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在公交站等候校车到来。

meanings.definition: Bad weather with strong wind and rain.
meanings.example: A big storm knocked down some tree branches last night.
meanings.example_cn: 昨晚一场大暴风雨刮倒了一些树枝。

meanings.definition: To rush at or attack something in an angry or forceful way.
meanings.example: The kids wanted to storm the castle during our pretend game.
meanings.example_cn: 我们假装游戏时，孩子们想猛攻城堡。

meanings.definition: Tasting like sugar or honey.
meanings.example: This apple is so sweet and juicy.
meanings.example_cn: 这个苹果又甜又多汁。

meanings.definition: Something that tastes like sugar or has a sugary flavor.
meanings.example: My grandma always keeps a jar of sweets on her kitchen counter for us to share.
meanings.example_cn: 奶奶总会在厨房台面上放一罐糖果，留给我们一起分着吃。

meanings.definition: To move through water using arms and legs.
meanings.example: We will swim in the pool after lunch.
meanings.example_cn: 午饭后我们去泳池游泳。

meanings.definition: The act of moving through water using your arms and legs.
meanings.example: We had a fun swim in the lake during our camping trip.
meanings.example_cn: 露营时我们在湖里游了个痛快。

meanings.definition: The back end of an animal.
meanings.example: The dog wagged its tail when it saw its owner.
meanings.example_cn: 狗看到主人时摇起了尾巴。

meanings.definition: To follow someone very closely.
meanings.example: The detective had to tail the suspect to see where he was going.
meanings.example_cn: 侦探不得不跟踪嫌疑人，看他去哪里。

meanings.definition: A story.
meanings.example: Grandpa told us a funny tale about when he was a boy.
meanings.example_cn: 爷爷给我们讲了一个他小时候的趣事。

meanings.definition: Brown skin from the sun.
meanings.example: After a week at the beach, I got a tan on my arms.
meanings.example_cn: 在海滩待了一周后，我的胳膊晒黑了。

meanings.definition: To make something brown with sunlight.
meanings.example: We got a tan on our arms after playing outside in the sun all afternoon.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在外面太阳下玩了一下午，胳膊都晒黑了。

meanings.definition: Something you aim at, such as in sports or shooting games.
meanings.example: The bullseye is the target you want to hit with your dart.
meanings.example_cn: 靶心就是你想用飞镖命中的目标。

meanings.definition: To aim at something or someone.
meanings.example: You need to target the center of the bullseye when you throw the dart.
meanings.example_cn: 投飞镖时你需要瞄准靶心。

meanings.definition: A goal or result that you try to achieve.
meanings.example: Her target is to read twenty books this year.
meanings.example_cn: 她今年的目标是读完二十本书。

meanings.definition: A small pie with fruit or other filling.
meanings.example: I ate a strawberry tart for dessert.
meanings.example_cn: 甜点我吃了一个草莓挞。

meanings.definition: A hot drink made from leaves.
meanings.example: My mom drinks a cup of hot tea every morning.
meanings.example_cn: 我妈妈每天早上喝一杯热茶。

meanings.definition: To help someone learn.
meanings.example: My mom will teach me how to ride a bike.
meanings.example_cn: 我妈妈会教我怎么骑自行车。

meanings.definition: To rip or pull apart.
meanings.example: Be careful not to tear your paper when erasing.
meanings.example_cn: 用橡皮擦时小心别把纸撕破。

meanings.definition: A drop of salty water that comes from your eye when you cry.
meanings.example: A single tear rolled down her cheek when she watched the sad movie.
meanings.example_cn: 她看那部悲伤的电影时，一滴眼泪从脸颊滚落。

meanings.definition: To make fun of someone in a playful or mean way.
meanings.example: It’s not nice to tease your friends about their mistakes.
meanings.example_cn: 拿朋友的错误开玩笑是不友好的。

meanings.definition: A person who likes to make fun of others in a playful or mean way.
meanings.example: He can be a tease when he hides his sister’s toys and laughs.
meanings.example_cn: 他把妹妹的玩具藏起来还笑，真是个爱逗人的家伙。

meanings.definition: A shelter made of cloth for camping.
meanings.example: We slept in a tent during our camping trip in the woods.
meanings.example_cn: 在树林里露营时我们睡在帐篷里。

meanings.definition: Used to compare two things.
meanings.example: My backpack is heavier than yours.
meanings.example_cn: 我的书包比你的重。

meanings.definition: A person who steals.
meanings.example: The thief tried to steal a bike from the park.
meanings.example_cn: 小偷想从公园里偷走一辆自行车。

meanings.definition: The feeling when you need a drink.
meanings.example: I felt thirst after playing outside in the sun.
meanings.example_cn: 在外面太阳下玩完后我感到口渴。

meanings.definition: A strong need or want for something, especially water.
meanings.example: After playing soccer, I had a big thirst for cold water.
meanings.example_cn: 踢完足球后，我特别想喝冰水。

meanings.definition: The inside part of your neck that food and air go through.
meanings.example: My throat hurts when I have a cold.
meanings.example_cn: 我感冒时喉咙疼。

meanings.definition: The loud noise after lightning.
meanings.example: The loud thunder made me jump during the storm.
meanings.example_cn: 暴风雨中那声巨响把我吓了一跳。

meanings.definition: To make a loud, deep noise, like thunder in a storm.
meanings.example: The train thundered down the tracks, making the ground shake.
meanings.example_cn: 火车轰隆轰隆地驶过铁轨，震得地面都在抖。

meanings.definition: A small clicking sound.
meanings.example: I heard the tick of the clock as I waited for my turn.
meanings.example_cn: 我等轮到自己时，听到时钟的滴答声。

meanings.definition: To make a small, regular clicking sound, like a clock.
meanings.example: I could hear the clock tick as I waited for class to start.
meanings.example_cn: 我等上课开始时，能听到时钟滴答滴答响。

meanings.definition: A small mark (✓) used to show that something is correct, finished, or chosen.
meanings.example: Put a tick next to the answers you know are correct.
meanings.example_cn: 在你确定正确的答案旁边打个勾。

meanings.definition: Clean and in order.
meanings.example: Please keep your desk tidy so you can find your things.
meanings.example_cn: 请保持书桌整齐，这样你才能找到东西。

meanings.definition: To make something neat and organized.
meanings.example: Please tidy your room before your friends come over.
meanings.example_cn: 朋友来之前请把你的房间整理好。

meanings.definition: A long ribbon for the neck.
meanings.example: He wore a red tie for the school concert.
meanings.example_cn: 学校音乐会他戴了一条红领带。

meanings.definition: To fasten things together with a knot.
meanings.example: Let’s tie the balloons together for the party decorations.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把气球系在一起做聚会装饰。

meanings.definition: A result in a game where no one wins because the scores are the same.
meanings.example: The soccer game ended in a tie, so both teams were happy.
meanings.example_cn: 足球比赛踢成了平局，两队都很开心。

meanings.definition: The pointed end.
meanings.example: The tip of my pencil broke, so I had to sharpen it.
meanings.example_cn: 我铅笔尖断了，所以不得不削尖它。

meanings.definition: To tilt something over.
meanings.example: Be careful not to tip your glass or the juice will spill.
meanings.example_cn: 小心别把杯子碰倒，不然果汁会洒出来。

meanings.definition: Extra money given to someone for good service, like in a restaurant.
meanings.example: Dad left a tip on the table for the waitress because she was so nice.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸在桌上给服务员留了小费，因为她人很好。

meanings.definition: One of the five small parts at the end of your foot.
meanings.example: I stubbed my toe on the corner of the bed.
meanings.example_cn: 我的脚趾撞到了床角。

meanings.definition: The highest point.
meanings.example: We climbed to the top of the hill to see the view.
meanings.example_cn: 我们爬到山顶去看风景。

meanings.definition: The highest or best.
meanings.example: She is the top student in her class this year.
meanings.example_cn: 她是今年班上的尖子生。

meanings.definition: To be greater than something else.
meanings.example: The new roller coaster will top all the others in height!
meanings.example_cn: 新过山车的高度会超过其他所有过山车！

meanings.definition: A trip or journey to visit places.
meanings.example: We went on a tour of the zoo and saw lots of animals.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去动物园参观，看到了很多动物。

meanings.definition: To travel around a place to see it.
meanings.example: Let’s tour the museum to see all the dinosaur bones.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去博物馆参观，看所有的恐龙骨头。

meanings.definition: Cars or vehicles on roads.
meanings.example: We were late because there was a lot of traffic on the way.
meanings.example_cn: 因为路上车很多，我们迟到了。

meanings.definition: To trade things in a way that is not allowed, often secretly.
meanings.example: It’s against the law to traffic rare animals.
meanings.example_cn: 走私珍稀动物是违法的。

meanings.definition: To carry goods or people from place to place.
meanings.example: Trucks are used to transport food to grocery stores.
meanings.example_cn: 卡车用来把食物运到杂货店。

meanings.definition: A way or system for carrying people or things from place to place.
meanings.example: The school bus is our main transport to get to school.
meanings.example_cn: 校车是我们上学的主要交通方式。

meanings.definition: Something used to catch animals or people.
meanings.example: The mouse was caught in a humane trap and then set free.
meanings.example_cn: 老鼠被一个人道的陷阱抓住，然后被放走了。

meanings.definition: To catch someone or something so they cannot get away.
meanings.example: We set a box to trap the mouse in the kitchen safely.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在厨房里设了个盒子，安全地困住那只老鼠。

meanings.definition: A trick used to catch someone or something.
meanings.example: The mouse ran into the trap and couldn’t get out.
meanings.example_cn: 老鼠跑进陷阱里，跑不出来了。

meanings.definition: To go to different places.
meanings.example: I would love to travel to different countries and see new places.
meanings.example_cn: 我想去不同的国家旅行，看看新地方。

meanings.definition: The act of going from one place to another.
meanings.example: Travel to new places can teach you a lot about the world.
meanings.example_cn: 去新地方旅行能让你了解很多关于世界的事。

meanings.definition: Something you care about a lot.
meanings.example: My seashell collection is my special treasure.
meanings.example_cn: 我的贝壳收藏是我特别的宝贝。

meanings.definition: To care about something very much and think it is important.
meanings.example: I treasure the necklace my grandma gave me more than anything.
meanings.example_cn: 我把奶奶给我的项链看得比什么都重。

meanings.definition: Valuable things, like gold, jewels, or anything special.
meanings.example: We found a treasure chest filled with shiny coins at the beach.
meanings.example_cn: 我们在海滩上发现了一个装满闪亮硬币的宝箱。

meanings.definition: A general direction something is moving in.
meanings.example: Wearing bright shoes is a trend at our school this year.
meanings.example_cn: 今年在我们学校穿亮色鞋子是一种潮流。

meanings.definition: To move or change in a certain direction, often becoming popular.
meanings.example: Short haircuts are starting to trend at my school this year.
meanings.example_cn: 今年在我们学校短发开始流行起来。

meanings.definition: A journey.
meanings.example: We went on a trip to the zoo and saw lots of animals.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去动物园旅行，看到了很多动物。

meanings.definition: To fall or almost fall because you hit your foot on something.
meanings.example: Be careful not to trip over your shoelaces when you run.
meanings.example_cn: 跑步时小心别被鞋带绊倒。

meanings.definition: To set something off.
meanings.example: The alarm was tripped when the cat jumped onto the kitchen counter.
meanings.example_cn: 猫跳到厨房台面上时，警报器被触发了。

meanings.definition: A problem or difficulty.
meanings.example: My little brother got in trouble for drawing on the wall.
meanings.example_cn: 我弟弟因为在墙上画画挨了骂。

meanings.definition: To cause problems.
meanings.example: Loud noises can trouble the baby and make it hard for her to sleep.
meanings.example_cn: 响声会打扰宝宝，让她难以入睡。

meanings.definition: To make someone feel worried.
meanings.example: It troubled me to see my friend looking so sad at school.
meanings.example_cn: 看到我朋友在学校那么难过，让我心里不安。

meanings.definition: To believe someone and feel safe with them.
meanings.example: I trust my best friend to keep my secrets.
meanings.example_cn: 我相信我最好的朋友会替我保守秘密。

meanings.definition: Belief that someone or something is honest and reliable.
meanings.example: I have trust in my best friend because she always keeps my secrets.
meanings.example_cn: 我信任我最好的朋友，因为她总是替我保守秘密。

meanings.definition: A song or melody.
meanings.example: That tune is stuck in my head all day!
meanings.example_cn: 那段旋律一整天都在我脑子里回响！

meanings.definition: To adjust a musical instrument or voice to the right pitch or sound.
meanings.example: Let’s tune the guitar before we start playing music.
meanings.example_cn: 开始演奏之前我们先调一下吉他。

meanings.definition: A passage dug through the ground.
meanings.example: We drove through a long tunnel under the mountain.
meanings.example_cn: 我们开车穿过了一条穿山的长隧道。

meanings.definition: To dig or make a tunnel in the ground.
meanings.example: The mole will tunnel under the ground to make its home.
meanings.example_cn: 鼹鼠会在地下挖洞做窝。

meanings.definition: To move around a point.
meanings.example: Turn the doorknob to open the door.
meanings.example_cn: 转动门把手来开门。

meanings.definition: Someone’s chance to do something.
meanings.example: It’s your turn to roll the dice in the board game.
meanings.example_cn: 桌游里轮到你掷骰子了。

meanings.definition: To become something different.
meanings.example: The leaves turn bright colors in the fall.
meanings.example_cn: 秋天树叶变成鲜艳的颜色。

meanings.definition: A private teacher.
meanings.example: My tutor helps me with math after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我的家教帮我辅导数学。

meanings.definition: To teach or help someone learn in a private lesson.
meanings.example: My older brother will tutor me in math after school.
meanings.example_cn: 放学后我哥哥会辅导我数学。

meanings.definition: To turn or wind something.
meanings.example: Twist the cap to open your water bottle.
meanings.example_cn: 拧开瓶盖打开你的水瓶。

meanings.definition: Something that happens in an unexpected way.
meanings.example: The story had a funny twist at the end that surprised everyone.
meanings.example_cn: 故事结尾有一个有趣的反转，让所有人都吃了一惊。

meanings.definition: Feeling unhappy or worried.
meanings.example: She felt upset when her ice cream fell on the ground.
meanings.example_cn: 冰淇淋掉在地上时，她心里很难过。

meanings.definition: To make someone feel unhappy.
meanings.example: Please don’t upset your sister by taking her favorite toy.
meanings.example_cn: 别拿你妹妹最喜欢的玩具惹她不高兴。

meanings.definition: A slight illness of the stomach.
meanings.example: Eating too much ice cream gave him a stomach upset.
meanings.example_cn: 冰淇淋吃太多让他胃不舒服。

meanings.definition: To do something with an object or tool.
meanings.example: I use a ruler to draw straight lines.
meanings.example_cn: 我用尺子画直线。

meanings.definition: To take advantage of something.
meanings.example: He learned to use every opportunity to learn something new.
meanings.example_cn: 他学会了利用每一个机会来学新东西。

meanings.definition: A way to use or do something with an object.
meanings.example: A pencil has many uses—you can write, draw, or even erase with it.
meanings.example_cn: 铅笔有很多用处——你可以写字、画画，甚至用它擦掉。

meanings.definition: A covered vehicle for carrying things or people.
meanings.example: The soccer team rode in a big van to the game.
meanings.example_cn: 足球队坐一辆大面包车去比赛。

meanings.definition: An animal doctor.
meanings.example: We took our puppy to the vet for a checkup.
meanings.example_cn: 我们带小狗去兽医那里做检查。

meanings.definition: To check or examine something carefully.
meanings.example: The teacher will vet each project idea before we start building.
meanings.example_cn: 我们开始动手做之前，老师会审查每个项目创意。

meanings.definition: To go and see someone or someplace.
meanings.example: We will visit Grandma on Sunday.
meanings.example_cn: 周日我们会去看奶奶。

meanings.definition: The act of going to see someone or someplace.
meanings.example: Our visit to the zoo was the best part of the weekend.
meanings.example_cn: 我们去动物园是周末最棒的部分。

meanings.definition: The sound made when speaking or singing.
meanings.example: She has a lovely singing voice.
meanings.example_cn: 她有一副动听的歌喉。

meanings.definition: To say or express your ideas or feelings.
meanings.example: You should voice your opinion if you have a good idea.
meanings.example_cn: 如果你有好主意，就应该说出来。

meanings.definition: An empty space.
meanings.example: The box was empty, just a big void inside.
meanings.example_cn: 盒子是空的，里面就是一个大空洞。

meanings.definition: Empty, having nothing inside.
meanings.example: The old house felt void and empty after everyone moved out.
meanings.example_cn: 大家搬走之后，老房子显得空空荡荡。

meanings.definition: Not valid.
meanings.example: My ticket was void because I tried to use it on the wrong day.
meanings.example_cn: 我的票失效了，因为我想在错误的那天用它。

meanings.definition: A person who offers to do something without being paid.
meanings.example: I am a volunteer at the animal shelter on weekends.
meanings.example_cn: 周末我在动物收容所做志愿者。

meanings.definition: To offer to help or do something without being asked or paid.
meanings.example: I want to volunteer to help clean up the park on Saturday.
meanings.example_cn: 我想周六志愿帮忙打扫公园。

meanings.definition: To stay until something happens.
meanings.example: Please wait your turn in line.
meanings.example_cn: 请排队等着轮到你。

meanings.definition: The time spent staying in one place until something happens.
meanings.example: There was a long wait at the doctor’s office before my name was called.
meanings.example_cn: 医生办公室里排了很久的队，才叫到我的名字。

meanings.definition: To stop sleeping.
meanings.example: I wake up early every morning for school.
meanings.example_cn: 每天早上我都早起去上学。

meanings.definition: To wish for something.
meanings.example: I want a puppy for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我生日想要一只小狗。

meanings.definition: To need or wish for something.
meanings.example: I want a puppy for my birthday.
meanings.example_cn: 我生日想要一只小狗。

meanings.definition: To clean with water.
meanings.example: Wash your hands before eating dinner.
meanings.example_cn: 晚饭前洗手。

meanings.definition: The act of getting something clean with water.
meanings.example: Give the car a good wash to make it shine.
meanings.example_cn: 把车好好洗一洗，让它发亮。

meanings.definition: Something useless or thrown away.
meanings.example: Throwing away good food is a waste.
meanings.example_cn: 把好食物扔掉是一种浪费。

meanings.definition: To use something in a careless way so that it is lost or not used well.
meanings.example: Don’t waste your food; only take what you can eat.
meanings.example_cn: 别浪费食物；只拿你吃得下的量。

meanings.definition: Not used, left over, or unnecessary.
meanings.example: We used the leftover wood for a birdhouse instead of throwing it away as waste material.
meanings.example_cn: 我们把剩下的木料做成了鸟屋，而不是当废料扔掉。

meanings.definition: A round object that turns and helps things move.
meanings.example: The wheel on my bike needs air.
meanings.example_cn: 我自行车的轮子需要打气。

meanings.definition: To push or move something that has wheels.
meanings.example: Can you wheel the shopping cart to the checkout line?
meanings.example_cn: 你能把购物车推到结账队列那里吗？

meanings.definition: A high, shrill sound.
meanings.example: I heard a loud whistle at the end of the game.
meanings.example_cn: 比赛结束时我听到一声响亮的哨声。

meanings.definition: To make a high sound by blowing air through your lips or a whistle.
meanings.example: I like to whistle a happy tune while I walk to school.
meanings.example_cn: 我走路上学时喜欢吹一首快乐的曲子。

meanings.definition: A small object that makes a high, shrill sound when you blow into it.
meanings.example: The referee blew his whistle to start the game.
meanings.example_cn: 裁判吹响哨子开始比赛。

meanings.definition: For what reason or purpose.
meanings.example: Why do cats like to chase string?
meanings.example_cn: 猫为什么喜欢追绳子？

meanings.definition: To come first or succeed.
meanings.example: Our team worked hard to win the soccer match.
meanings.example_cn: 我们队努力拼搏，赢了足球赛。

meanings.definition: A victory or when you succeed in a game or contest.
meanings.example: Our team celebrated the big win after the soccer game.
meanings.example_cn: 足球赛结束后我们队庆祝这场大胜。

meanings.definition: A thin piece of metal used for carrying electricity or fastening things.
meanings.example: Dad used a wire to fix the broken lamp.
meanings.example_cn: 爸爸用一根铁丝修好了坏了的灯。

meanings.definition: To connect things using wire.
meanings.example: The electrician will wire the new lights in the classroom.
meanings.example_cn: 电工将把新灯的线接到教室里。

meanings.definition: A feeling of surprise and amazement.
meanings.example: The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder that amazes everyone who sees it.
meanings.example_cn: 大峡谷是一个自然奇观，让每个见到它的人都惊叹。

meanings.definition: To feel curious or want to know more about something.
meanings.example: I wonder what it would be like to live on another planet.
meanings.example_cn: 我想知道住在另一个星球上会是什么样子。

meanings.definition: Something that is amazing or makes you feel surprised.
meanings.example: The Grand Canyon is a natural wonder that many people visit.
meanings.example_cn: 大峡谷是许多人参观的自然奇观。

meanings.definition: To feel anxious or troubled.
meanings.example: Don’t worry about the test; just do your best.
meanings.example_cn: 别担心考试；尽力就好。

meanings.definition: A feeling of concern or nervousness about something.
meanings.example: I had a worry about forgetting my homework at home.
meanings.example_cn: 我担心把作业忘在家里了。

meanings.definition: Not correct.
meanings.example: My answer was wrong, so I tried again.
meanings.example_cn: 我的答案错了，所以我又试了一次。

meanings.definition: An action that is unfair, unjust, or not right.
meanings.example: It’s a wrong to take something that doesn’t belong to you.
meanings.example_cn: 拿不属于你的东西是不对的。

meanings.definition: To treat someone unfairly or do something bad to them.
meanings.example: It’s wrong to blame someone else for something you did.
meanings.example_cn: 把自己做的事怪到别人头上是不对的。

meanings.definition: The number 0.
meanings.example: I have zero homework tonight!
meanings.example_cn: 我今晚的作业是零！

meanings.definition: None or not any at all.
meanings.example: There was zero candy left in the bowl after the party.
meanings.example_cn: 聚会之后碗里一点糖都没剩。

meanings.definition: To set something back to zero or adjust it to nothing.
meanings.example: Let’s zero the scale before we weigh the fruit.
meanings.example_cn: 称水果之前我们先把秤归零。

meanings.definition: To move very quickly from one place to another.
meanings.example: The rabbit can zip across the yard faster than any other animal.
meanings.example_cn: 这只兔子窜过院子的速度比任何其他动物都快。

meanings.definition: To close something using a zipper.
meanings.example: Don’t forget to zip your backpack so nothing falls out.
meanings.example_cn: 别忘了拉上你的背包拉链，免得东西掉出来。

meanings.definition: A fastener for clothes.
meanings.example: The zip on my jacket got stuck, so I couldn’t close it all the way.
meanings.example_cn: 我外套上的拉链卡住了，没办法完全拉上。
